tasks.objective_text_zh: 尘泥沼泽北部的马德克拉什要你去抓8条泥鳍小鱼。

tasks.name: 塞拉摩间谍
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill 9 Theramore Infiltrators, then return to Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀掉9个塞拉摩间谍，然后回到蕨墙村去见纳泽尔·血矛。

tasks.name: 塞拉摩码头
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Captain's Documents to Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把指挥官的文件交给蕨墙村的纳泽尔·血矛。

tasks.name: 加尔的剑
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring Razorspine's Sword to "Swamp Eye" Jarl at Swamplight Manor.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将刺脊的剑交给尘泥沼泽的"沼泽之眼"加尔。

tasks.name: 加尔和蜘蛛眼
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 20 Unpopped Darkmist Eyes to "Swamp Eye" Jarl at the Swamplight Manor.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 收集20颗黑雾蜘蛛的眼球，把它们交给水光庄园的"沼泽之眼"加尔。

tasks.name: 沼泽蛙的腿
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 10 Marsh Frog Legs to "Swamp Eye" Jarl in Dustwallow Marsh.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 为尘泥沼泽的"沼泽之眼"加尔收集10条沼泽蛙的腿。

tasks.name: 遗失的报告
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Spy's Report to Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把间谍的报告交给蕨墙村的纳泽尔·血矛。

tasks.name: 被取下的徽记
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Defiant Orc Head to Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把兽人的徽记交给蕨墙村的纳泽尔·血矛。

tasks.name: 巨魔巫医
tasks.objective_text_en: Take the Defiant Orc Head to Kin'weelay in the Grom'gol Base Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把兽人的徽记带到荆棘谷的格罗姆高营地里，交给肯维雷。

tasks.name: 黑色盾牌
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Blackened Iron Shield to Krog in Brackenwall Village.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把被熏黑的铁盾牌带给蕨墙村的克罗格。

tasks.name: 玛尔格的嘱托
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Jeweled Pendant to Nazeer in Brackenwall Village.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把宝石坠饰带给蕨墙村的纳泽尔·血矛。

tasks.name: 向佐尔报告
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Jeweled Pendant to Zor Lonetree in Orgrimmar.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把镶宝石饰品带给奥格瑞玛的佐尔·孤树。

tasks.name: 可疑的蹄印
tasks.objective_text_en: Report about the suspicious prints at the Shady Rest Inn to Krog in Brackenwall Village.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把树荫旅店的可疑蹄印报告给蕨墙村的克罗格。

tasks.name: 帕瓦尔·雷瑟上尉
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring Reethe's Badge to Krog in Brackenwall Village.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把雷瑟的徽章带给蕨墙村的克罗格。

tasks.name: 黑色盾牌
tasks.objective_text_en: Show the Blackened Iron Shield to Mosarn in Thunder Bluff.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把被熏黑的铁盾牌拿给雷霆崖的莫萨恩看一看。

tasks.name: 黑色盾牌
tasks.objective_text_en: Show the Blackened Iron Shield to Do'gol in Brackenwall Village.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把被熏黑的铁盾牌拿给蕨墙村的杜高尔看一看。

tasks.name: 黑色盾牌
tasks.objective_text_en: Acquire 5 Acidic Venom Sacs for Do'gol in Brackenwall Village.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 为蕨墙村的杜高尔收集5个酸性毒囊。

tasks.name: 黑色盾牌
tasks.objective_text_en: Talk with Krog in Brackenwall Village.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 和蕨墙村的克罗格谈一谈。

tasks.name: 黎明号的黄昏
tasks.objective_text_en: Balandar Brightstar in Brackenwall Village wants you to reclaim the Dawn Runner Cargo and rescue his first mate Ithania from forces of Theramore at North Point Tower.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 前往北点哨塔，从塞拉摩军队手中夺回黎明号的货物，搭救大副伊萨妮亚，然后返回蕨墙村向巴尔兰达·新星复命。

tasks.name: 调查废墟
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak to Inspector Tarem at the Shady Rest Inn.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 去和树荫旅店的调查员塔雷姆谈一谈。

tasks.name: 憎恨的精华
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 10 Black Dragonkin Essences to Brogg at Mudsprocket.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将10份黑龙精华交给泥链镇的布洛格。

tasks.name: 恐怖图腾的武器
tasks.objective_text_en: Apprentice Garion at Tabetha's Farm wants you to test the Captured Totem on 10 Mottled Drywallow Crocolisks or Drywallow Daggermaws.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 塔贝萨农场的学徒加里奥希望你在10头尘泥杂斑鳄鱼身上测试被捕获的图腾。

tasks.name: 坠毁的飞艇
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Moxie Steelgrille at Beezil's Wreck.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与比吉尔的飞艇残骸处的莫希·斯蒂格里谈一谈。

tasks.name: 沼泽中的毒药
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 6 vials of Marsh Venom to Apprentice Garion at Tabetha's Farm.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将6瓶沼泽毒药交给塔贝萨农场的学徒加里奥。

tasks.name: 女巫岭的幽灵
tasks.objective_text_en: Mordant Grimsby at Swamplight Manor wants you to gather information from 10 Risen Husks or Risen Spirits.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 水光庄园的摩丹特·格雷斯比希望你能从10个复活的躯壳或复活的游魂身上收集到信息。

tasks.name: 除巫草
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 9 sprigs of Witchbane to Mordant Grimsby at Swamplight Manor.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将9根除巫草交给水光庄园的摩丹特·格雷斯比。

tasks.name: 净化女巫岭
tasks.objective_text_en: Mordant Grimsby at Swamplight Manor wants you to plant the torch at the end of the dock and defeat anything that appears.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 水光庄园的摩丹特·格雷斯比希望你将火把放置在码头的尽头，并打败随后出现的任何东西。

tasks.name: 背叛的端倪？
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Sealed Letter to Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将密封的信函交给蕨墙村的纳泽尔·血矛。

tasks.name: 绝非偶然
tasks.objective_text_en: Krog at Brackenwall Village wants you to bring him 7 Blackhoof Armaments.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 蕨墙村的克罗格希望你去收集7份黑蹄军备。

tasks.name: 恐怖图腾的密谋
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Grimtotem Battle Plan to Krog at Brackenwall Village.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把恐怖图腾作战计划交给蕨墙村的克罗格。

tasks.name: 寻找塔贝萨
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Tabetha at her farm in the Quagmire.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 前往泥潭沼泽的农场，与那里的塔贝萨谈一谈。

tasks.name: 向克罗格汇报
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Krog at Brackenwall Village.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与蕨墙村的克罗格谈一谈。

tasks.name: 烧毁恐角岗哨！
tasks.objective_text_en: Burn the North Tent, East Tent, and the Northeast Tent at Direhorn Post, then return to Tabetha at her farm.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 烧毁恐角岗哨的北部帐篷、东部帐篷和东北部帐篷，然后回到塔贝萨的农场，向塔贝萨复命。

tasks.name: 伸张正义
tasks.objective_text_en: Return to Krog at Brackenwall Village.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 回到蕨墙村的克罗格那里复命。

tasks.name: 回收货物！
tasks.objective_text_en: Moxie Steelgrille at Beezil's Wreck wants you to recover 8 pieces of Zeppelin Cargo.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 比吉尔的飞艇残骸处的莫希·斯蒂格里要你找回8件飞艇上的货物。

tasks.name: 给德拉兹特的货物
tasks.objective_text_en: Take the Zeppelin Cargo to Drazzit Dripvalve at Mudsprocket.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把飞艇上的货物交给泥链镇的德拉兹特·迪普瓦尔。

tasks.name: 女巫岭的隐士
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with "Swamp Eye" Jarl at Swamplight Manor.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与水光庄园的"沼泽之眼"加尔谈一谈。

tasks.name: 布莱克摩尔的余孽
tasks.objective_text_en: Return the information gathered by Gol'dir to Krusk in Tarren Mill.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把高迪尔收集的消息带给塔伦米尔的克鲁斯克。

tasks.name: 奥里登·匹瑞诺德
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill Lord Aliden Perenolde and ask his mistress, Elysa, about Taretha's pendant.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀了奥里登·匹瑞诺德领主，并从他的情人艾丽萨身上拿回塔蕾莎的项链。

tasks.name: 塔蕾莎的礼物
tasks.objective_text_en: Return Taretha's pendant to Krusk at Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把塔蕾莎的项链交还给希尔斯布莱德丘陵中塔伦米尔的克鲁斯克。

tasks.name: 破除天灾
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Mudsnout Mixture, a Strong Troll's Blood Potion, 5 Daggerspine Scales and 5 Torn Fin Eyes to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把泥头花水、1瓶强力巨魔之血药水、5块刺脊纳迦的鳞片和5颗碎鳍鱼人的眼球交给塔伦米尔的药剂师林度恩。

tasks.name: 破除天灾
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring a keg of Shindigger Stout to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将一桶矿工烈酒交给塔伦米尔的药剂师林度恩。

tasks.name: 意志之冠
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill 10 Crushridge Maulers for Melisara in Tarren Mill.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 塔伦米尔的梅里萨拉要你去杀掉10个破碎岭虐待者。

tasks.name: 意志之冠
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill Targ, Muckrake, and Glommus and bring their heads to Melisara in Tarren Mill.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 干掉塔尔格、玛克拉克和戈洛姆斯，把他们的徽记带给塔伦米尔的梅里萨拉。

tasks.name: 意志之冠
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill Mug'Thol, and return his head with the Crown of Will to Melisara in Tarren Mill.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀了玛格索尔，带着他的徽记和意志之冠去塔伦米尔见梅里萨拉。

tasks.name: 意志之冠
tasks.objective_text_en: Deliver the Crown of Will to Sharlindra in the Undercity.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把意志之冠交给幽暗城的沙琳德拉。

tasks.name: 破除天灾
tasks.objective_text_en: Place the Tainted Keg on the rug for the captured farmers.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把装满烈酒的酒桶放在被俘农夫房间的地毯上。

tasks.name: 秘密潜入
tasks.objective_text_en: Retrieve information about Gol'dir's whereabouts for Krusk in Tarren Mill.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把关于高迪尔下落的消息带回来给塔伦米尔的克鲁斯克。

tasks.name: 希尔斯布莱德之战
tasks.objective_text_en: Travel to Dun Garok and kill 8 Mountaineers, 4 Riflemen, 2 Priests and Captain Ironhill and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 到丹加洛克去杀掉8个巡山人、4个火枪手、2个牧师，还有达伦·铁山上尉，然后回到塔伦米尔向达萨利亚汇报。

tasks.name: 誓死追赃
tasks.objective_text_en: Find the traitors and recover their artifacts, then return to Magus Voidglare in Tarren Mill.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 找到被遗忘者的叛徒，取回他们偷走的神器，然后回到塔伦米尔去见大法师沃迪恩·伍德格莱尔。

finish_entities.name: 大法师沃迪恩·伍德格莱尔

tasks.name: 达拉然巡逻队
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill 6 Dalaran Summoners and 12 Elemental Slaves, then return to Magus Voidglare in Tarren Mill.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀掉6个达拉然召唤师和12个元素奴仆，然后回到塔伦米尔去见大法师沃迪恩·伍德格莱尔。

start_entities.name: 大法师沃迪恩·伍德格莱尔

finish_entities.name: 大法师沃迪恩·伍德格莱尔

tasks.name: 亨伯特的长剑
tasks.objective_text_en: Retrieve Deathguard Humbert's sword from Dun Garok and return it to him in Tarren Mill.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 从丹加洛克拿回亡灵卫兵亨伯特的长剑，然后回到塔伦米尔把剑还给他。

tasks.name: 希尔斯布莱德之战
tasks.objective_text_en: Take Darthalia's Sealed Commendation to Bragor Bloodfist in the Undercity.

tasks.name: 赫尔库拉的复仇
tasks.objective_text_en: Retrieve Helcular's Rod from the Yeti and bring it back to Novice Thaivand in Tarren Mill.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 从雪怪手上拿回赫尔库拉的魔棒，把它交给塔伦米尔的学徒塞万德。

tasks.name: 赫尔库拉的复仇
tasks.objective_text_en: Charge the Rod of Helcular with the powers of the Flame of Azel, Flame of Veraz and the Flame of Uzel.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将埃希尔之焰、沃拉兹之焰和尤基尔之焰的力量注入赫尔库拉的魔棒。 /  / 把经过仪式洗礼之后的魔棒带到南海镇的赫尔库拉墓地。

tasks.name: 石雕
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 10 Worn Stone Tokens to Keeper Bel'varil in Tarren Mill.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 收集10个用旧的石雕，把它们带给塔伦米尔的看守者贝尔杜加。

tasks.name: 地缚护腕
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 4 Bracers of Earth Binding to Keeper Bel'varil in Tarren Mill.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 为塔伦米尔的看守者贝瓦里尔收集4个地缚护腕。

tasks.name: 通缉：瓦杜斯男爵
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill Baron Vardus and deliver his head to High Executor Darthalia in Tarren Mill.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀了瓦杜斯男爵，把他的徽记带给塔伦米尔的高级执行官达萨利亚。

tasks.name: 落锤之战
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill 8 Boulderfist Ogres and 10 Boulderfist Enforcers, then find Drum Fel in the Hammerfall outpost in Arathi Highlands.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀掉8个石拳食人魔和10个石拳执行者，然后去阿拉希高地的落锤村哨所找杜拉姆法尔。

tasks.name: 希尔斯布莱德之战
tasks.objective_text_en: Take Darthalia's Sealed Commendation to Bragor Bloodfist in the Undercity.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把达萨利亚的密封褒奖状交给幽暗城的布拉贡·血拳。

tasks.name: 意志之冠
tasks.objective_text_en: Report to Melisara at Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 到希尔斯布莱德丘陵去，向塔伦米尔的梅里萨拉报到。

tasks.name: 科娜塔一家
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring Kenata, Fardel, and Marcel Dabyrie's Heads to Genavie Callow in Undercity.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将科娜塔、法迪尔和马塞尔的徽记交给幽暗城的吉纳维·卡隆。

tasks.name: 沼泽中的梦境粉尘
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 10 Specks of Dream Dust to Krazek in Booty Bay. Dream Dust is gathered from the dragon whelps of the Swamp of Sorrows.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 为藏宝海湾的克拉兹克收集10份梦境粉尘。

tasks.name: 德莱尼水晶
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 6 Draenethyst crystals to Magtoor at The Harborage in the Swamp of Sorrows.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 给悲伤沼泽避难营地里的玛格图尔带去6块德莱尼水晶。

tasks.name: 木棒诺博鲁
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring Noboru's Cudgel to the leader of The Harborage in the Swamp of Sorrows.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把诺博鲁的木棒交到悲伤沼泽中的避难营领导人手中。

tasks.name: 尼卡·血痕
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Neeka Bloodscar.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 和尼卡·血痕谈一谈。

tasks.name: 海中的威胁
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak to Katar in the Swamp of Sorrows.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与悲伤沼泽的卡塔尔谈一谈。

tasks.name: 海中的威胁
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Tok'Kar in the Swamp of Sorrows.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与悲伤沼泽的托克卡尔谈一谈。

tasks.name: 正在忙碌的希拉
tasks.objective_text_en: Check back with Sirra later to see if he's still busy.

tasks.name: 沙普塔隆的爪子
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring Sharptalon's Claw to Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将沙普塔隆的爪子交给灰谷碎木哨岗的塞娜尼·雷心。

tasks.name: 丢失的书页
tasks.objective_text_en: Find the 12 missing pages of the Shredder Operating Manual, and put them together to form Chapters 1, 2, and 3. Return the pages to Gurda Ragescar near Splintertree Post.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 找到丢失的12页伐木机操作指南，把它们合并为第1、2、3章。然后带着这些书页回到碎木岗哨去找古尔达·怒痕。

tasks.name: 阿奎尼斯男爵
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Strange Water Globe to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把奇怪的水球交给灰谷佐拉姆加前哨站的耶努萨克雷。

tasks.name: 毁灭燃烧军团
tasks.objective_text_en: Slay 6 Mannoroc Lashers, 6 Felguards and 6 Searing Infernals, and then return to Valusha at Splintertree Post in Ashenvale.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀死6个玛诺洛克鞭笞者、6个恶魔守卫和6个灼热的地狱火，然后向灰谷碎木岗哨的瓦鲁莎复命。

tasks.name: 恶魔的计划
tasks.objective_text_en: Deliver the Diabolical Plans to Valusha at Splintertree Post in Ashenvale.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将恶魔的计划交给灰谷碎木岗哨的瓦鲁莎。

tasks.name: 休想！
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill Gorgannon and Diathorus the Seeker.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀死戈加农和搜寻者迪亚索鲁斯。

tasks.name: 让他们失眠！
tasks.objective_text_en: Deep within the Slag Pit of the Cauldron, you will find the sleeping quarters of the Dark Iron dwarves.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在大熔炉的熔渣之池深处，你可以发现黑铁矮人的休息区。 /  / 到休息区去偷走20只黑铁枕头。当你完成任务后就回到灼热峡谷的艾沃奈斯那里复命。

tasks.objective_text_en: Recover all three gems and a power source for the necklace from Uldaman, and then bring them to Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath. Jarkal believes a power source might be found on the strongest construct present in Uldaman.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 从奥达曼找回项链上的所有三块宝石和能量源，然后把它们交给卡加斯的加卡尔。 /  / 红宝石被藏在暗影矮人层层设防的地区。 /  / 黄宝石藏在穴居人活动地区的一个瓮中。 /  / 蓝宝石在格瑞姆洛克手中，他是穴居人的领袖。 /  / 能量源可能在奥达曼的某个最强生物的手中。

tasks.name: 摩克萨尔丁的魔法
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 10 Jungle Stalker Feathers to Far Seer Mok'thardin at the Grom'gol base camp.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 给格罗姆高营地的先知摩克萨尔丁带回10根丛林捕猎者的羽毛。

tasks.name: 血帆海盗
tasks.objective_text_en: Fleet Master Seahorn in Booty Bay wants you to kill 10 Bloodsail Swashbucklers and bring back the Bloodsail Charts and the Bloodsail Orders.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 藏宝海岸的舰队指挥官海角要求你杀死10名血帆流氓并将血帆海图和血帆计划书带回去。

tasks.name: 吓唬病鬼
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 5 Mistvale Giblets to "Shaky" Phillipe in Booty Bay.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 给藏宝海湾的"病鬼"菲利普带回5块薄雾谷猩猩的内脏。

tasks.name: 戈杜尼卷轴
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Gordunni Scroll to Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将戈杜尼卷轴交给莫沙彻营地的洛克·奥汉。

tasks.name: 戈杜尼钴矿石
tasks.objective_text_en: Orwin Gizzmick in Camp Mojache wants 12 samples of Gordunni Cobalt.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 莫沙彻营地的奥尔文·吉兹米克需要12块戈杜尼钴矿石的样本。

tasks.name: 戈杜尼宝珠
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Gordunni Orb to Uthel'nay in the Darkbriar Lodge in Orgrimmar.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将戈杜尼宝珠交给奥格瑞玛暗木小屋里的尤塞尔奈。

tasks.name: 向费泽鲁尔复命
tasks.objective_text_en: Return to Fel'Zerul in Stonard.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 向斯通纳德的费泽鲁尔回报。

tasks.name: 邪恶的魔法
tasks.objective_text_en: Retrieve Marez Cowl's Bloodstone Orb and bring it to Tor'gan in Hammerfall.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 取回玛雷兹·考尔的血石宝珠，把它交给落锤村的托尔甘。

tasks.name: 真正的威胁
tasks.objective_text_en: Slay Or'Kalar and bring his Head to Korin Fel in the Hammerfall outpost.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀死奥卡拉尔，将他的徽记带给落锤村哨所的科林法尔。

tasks.name: 谢申克的救赎
tasks.objective_text_en: Discover the fate of Junior Surveyor Scrimshank, and bring either him or his surveying equipment to Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser in Gadgetzan.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 寻找初级勘探员谢申克的下落，把他或者他的勘探设备交给加基森的高级勘探员菲兹杜瑟。

tasks.name: 异种蝎的威胁
tasks.objective_text_en: Take the report to Zilzibin Drumlore in Orgrimmar.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把报告带给奥格瑞玛的基尔兹宾·鼓眼。

tasks.name: 昆虫研究
tasks.objective_text_en: Check in Gadgetzan for Alchemist Pestlezugg and his analysis of the insect parts.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 到加基森的炼金师匹斯特苏格那里去了解关于昆虫的研究有没有新的进展。

tasks.name: 昆虫研究
tasks.objective_text_en: Deliver the report to Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser in Gadgetzan. Be sure he gives you a copy of the report, as Alchemist Pestlezugg has requested.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把这份报告带给加基森的高级勘探员菲兹杜瑟，让他按照炼金师匹斯特苏格的要求为你复制一份报告。

tasks.name: 死沼巨鳄
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring Deadmire's Tooth to Melor in Thunder Bluff.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把死沼巨鳄的牙齿带给雷霆崖的梅洛。

tasks.name: 挑战黑龙军团
tasks.objective_text_en: Plant the Stonemaul Banner near the entrance to Onyxia's Lair, wait for Onyxia's response, then return to Brogg at Mudsprocket.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将石槌战旗插在奥妮克希亚的巢穴入口附近，等待奥妮克希亚的回应，然后回去向泥链镇的布洛格复命。

tasks.name: 阻止腐蚀
tasks.objective_text_en: Moxie Steelgrille wants you to dissolve 10 oozes and report back to her at Beezil's Wreck.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 莫希·斯蒂格里希望你去溶解10只软泥怪，然后回到比吉尔的飞艇残骸旁向她复命。

tasks.name: 帮助泥链镇
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Drazzit Dripvalve at Mudsprocket.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与泥链镇的德拉兹特·迪普瓦尔谈一谈。

tasks.name: 缺乏补给
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 6 Sawtooth Snapper Claws to Tok'Kar in the Swamp of Sorrows.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 给悲伤沼泽的托克卡尔带去6只盐齿钳嘴鳄的爪子。

tasks.name: 一点食物
tasks.objective_text_en: Feed the Fel-Tainted Morsels to the Lost Ones' captured animals. Then return the leftovers to Cersei Dusksinger at Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将邪恶侵蚀的食物喂给被失落者捕获的猎物。然后将剩余的饲料带回去交给悲伤沼泽斯通纳德的瑟尔希-暗歌。

tasks.name: 血顶徽记
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring Gan'zulah's Head and Nezzliok's Head to the bubbling cauldron at the Grom'gol Base Camp.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将甘祖拉恩的徽记和奈兹里奥克的徽记带回格罗姆高营地，放入冒泡的大锅中。

tasks.name: 玛雷的腿
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring Maury's Key to "Sea Wolf" Mackinley in Booty Bay.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把玛雷的钥匙带给藏宝海湾的"海狼"马克基雷。

tasks.name: 赞吉尔的秘密
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 12 samples of Zanzil's Mixture to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 收集12份赞吉尔的药剂，把它们交给藏宝海湾的克兰克·菲兹巴布。

tasks.name: 与豺狼人开战
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 10 Woodpaw Gnoll Manes to Hadoken Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将10份木爪豺狼人的鬃毛交给莫沙彻营地的哈杜肯·迅蹄。

tasks.name: 调查木爪岭
tasks.objective_text_en: Find the gnoll battle plans somewhere in the gnoll camps to the south of Camp Mojache.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在莫沙彻营地以南的豺狼人营地中寻找豺狼人的战斗计划。

tasks.name: 作战计划
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Woodpaw Battle Plans to Hadoken Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把木爪豺狼人的作战计划交给莫沙彻营地的哈杜肯·迅蹄。

tasks.name: 可怕的发现
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 20 Grimtotem Horns to Krueg Skullsplitter in Camp Mojache.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 收集20支恐怖图腾之角，把它们交给莫沙彻营地的克鲁伊格·碎颅。

tasks.name: 祖卡什报告
tasks.objective_text_en: Deliver the Camp Mojache Zukk'ash Report to Zilzibin Drumlore. He resides in the Drag of Orgrimmar.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把莫沙彻营地祖卡什报告交给奥格瑞玛暗巷区的基尔兹宾·鼓眼。

tasks.name: 神灵哈卡
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Filled Egg of Hakkar to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.

tasks.name: 失落的摩沙鲁石板
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Third and Fourth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把第三块和第四块摩沙鲁石板交给塔纳利斯的勘查员詹斯·铁靴。

tasks.name: 赫鲁萨可汗
tasks.objective_text_en: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring the Maraudine Key Fragment to Uthek the Wise in the Gelkis Village.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 继续和吉尔吉斯部族保持良好的关系，把玛洛迪钥匙碎片交给吉尔吉斯村的智者乌泰克。

tasks.name: 赫鲁萨可汗
tasks.objective_text_en: Maintain your Magram reputation, and bring the Maraudine Key Fragment to Warug in the Magram Village in Desolace.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 和玛格拉姆保持良好的关系，把玛洛迪钥匙碎片交给凄凉之地玛格拉姆村的瓦鲁格。

tasks.name: 塔纳利斯的样本
tasks.objective_text_en: Acquire untested samples for 8 basilisks, 8 hyenas, and 8 scorpions. Bring the testing kit back to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan before the power source runs out.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 收集8份蜥蜴样本、8份土狼样本和8份蝎子样本，然后在能量源耗尽之前把野外实验工具包还给加基森的首席工程师比格维兹。

finish_entities.name: 首席工程师沙克斯·比格维兹

tasks.name: 废土的公正
tasks.objective_text_en: Take down 10 Wastewander Bandits and Thieves east of Gadgetzan, then report back to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 去加基森的东面杀掉10个废土窃贼和10个废土强盗，然后向总工程师比格维兹复命。

start_entities.name: 首席工程师沙克斯·比格维兹

finish_entities.name: 首席工程师沙克斯·比格维兹

tasks.name: 收集水袋
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 5 Wastewander Water Pouches to Spigot Operator Luglunket in Gadgetzan.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 收集5只废土水袋，把它们交给加基森的鲁格伦克。

tasks.name: 探水棒
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Divino-matic Rod to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把探水棒交给加基森的首席工程师沙克斯-比格维兹。

start_entities.name: 首席工程师沙克斯·比格维兹

finish_entities.name: 首席工程师沙克斯·比格维兹

tasks.name: 深渊皇冠
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Tiara of the Deep to Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.

tasks.name: 塔贝萨的任务
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.

start_entities.name: 安娜斯塔西娅·哈特威尔

tasks.name: 特兰雷克
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Tran'rek in Gadgetzan.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与加基森的特兰雷克谈一谈。

tasks.name: 圣甲虫的壳
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 5 Uncracked Scarab Shells to Tran'rek in Gadgetzan.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 给加基森的特兰雷克带去5个完整的圣甲虫壳。

tasks.name: 斯杜雷的债务
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Stoley in Steamwheedle Port.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与热砂港的斯杜雷谈一谈。

tasks.name: 斯杜雷的货物
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring Stoley's Shipment to Stoley in Steamwheedle Port.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将斯杜雷的货物交给热砂港的斯杜雷。

tasks.name: 给马克基雷的货物
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring Stoley's Bottle to "Sea Wolf" MacKinley in Booty Bay.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将斯杜雷的瓶子交给藏宝海湾的"海狼"马克基雷。

tasks.name: 船运时刻表
tasks.objective_text_en: Report the Ship Schedules to an authority in Steamwheedle Port.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把船运时刻表交给热砂港的某个官员。

finish_entities.name: 安全主管吉罗姆·比格维兹

tasks.name: 摩沙鲁的预言
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the First and Second Mosh'aru Tablets to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将第一块和第二块摩沙鲁石板交给塔纳利斯的叶基亚。

tasks.name: 拉斯塔哈之手
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Molthor in Stranglethorn.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 跟荆棘谷的莫托尔谈一谈。

tasks.name: 惩戒火炬
tasks.objective_text_en: Take the Torch of Retribution.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 拿起惩戒火炬。

tasks.name: 侍卫玛特拉克
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Squire Maltrake.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与侍卫玛特拉克谈一谈。

tasks.name: 烧掉它们！
tasks.objective_text_en: Set the North, South, East, and West Sentry Towers on fire by using the Torch of Retribution inside each of the buildings.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 使用惩戒火炬点燃北部、南部、东部和西部的哨塔。

tasks.name: 打开箱子...
tasks.objective_text_en: Open the chest.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 打开箱子。

tasks.name: 威士忌斯利姆的酒
tasks.objective_text_en: Whiskey Slim in Booty Bay wants you to bring him the bottles of Pupellyverbos Port he lost.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 藏宝海湾的威士忌斯利姆想要你帮他找回弄丢的紫葡萄酒。

tasks.name: 血帆海盗
tasks.objective_text_en: Fleet-Master Seahorn in Booty Bay wants you to kill Captain Stillwater, Captain Keelhaul and Fleet Master Firallon.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 藏宝海湾的舰队指挥官卡拉-海角要求你杀死血帆海盗的斯蒂沃特船长，尼哈鲁船长和舰队指挥官菲尔拉伦。

tasks.name: 面对叶基亚
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Yeh'kinya.

tasks.name: 船长的箱子
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring Smotts' Chest to Hecklebury Smotts in Booty Bay.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将斯莫特的箱子交给藏宝海湾的海克拜瑞·斯莫特。

tasks.name: 挑战奈古拉什
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 10 Barbecued Buzzard Wings and 5 bottles of Junglevine Wine to Captain Smotts' Lifeboat.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将10块烧烤秃鹰翅膀和5瓶密林葡萄酒带到斯莫特船长的救生艇上去。 /  / 然后杀死奈古拉什，将斯莫特的弯刀交给荆棘谷的斯莫特船长。

tasks.name: 遗失的卷轴碎片
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Torn Scroll Fragment, the Crumpled Scroll Fragment and the Singed Scroll Fragment to Theldurin the Lost.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把破损的卷轴碎片、弄皱的卷轴碎片和烧焦的卷轴碎片带给迷失者塞尔杜林。

tasks.name: 破碎的联盟
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill Boss Tho'grun and bring the Sign of the Earth to Gorn in Kargath.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀掉索格伦，把大地印章交给卡加斯的高恩。

tasks.name: 白金圆盘
tasks.objective_text_en: Take the miniature version of the Discs of Norgannon to the one of the sages in Thunder Bluff.

tasks.name: 寻找OOX-22/FE！
tasks.objective_text_en: Take the distress beacon to Oglethorpe's homing robot in a cave near Feral Scar Vale.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把定位器带到深痕谷附近山洞中的奥格索普的导航机器人旁边。

tasks.name: 新斗篷的光辉
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 10 Iridescent Sprite Darter Wings to Krueg Skullsplitter in Camp Mojache.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 给莫沙彻营地的克鲁伊格·碎颅带去10个闪光的小精灵翅膀。

tasks.name: 菲拉斯的食人魔
tasks.objective_text_en: Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache wants you to kill 10 Gordunni Ogres, 10 Gordunni Ogre-Magi, and 5 Gordunni Brutes.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 莫沙彻营地的洛卡-奥赫要你杀掉10个戈杜尼食人魔、10个戈杜尼食人魔法师和5个戈杜尼蛮兵。

tasks.name: 奇怪的要求
tasks.objective_text_en: Take the Shrunken Head to Xerash Fireblade at the Lariss Pavilion in Feralas.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将皱缩的徽记交给拉瑞斯小亭的夏拉什·火刃。

tasks.name: 向巫医尤克里回复
tasks.objective_text_en: Deliver Xerash's Herb Pouch to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Feralas.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将尼尔鲁的草药包送给菲拉斯的巫医尤克里。

tasks.name: 测试容器
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill 10 Ironfur Bears or Longtooth Runners, and use the Beast Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen beasts.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 去杀掉10头铁鬃熊或是长牙奔跑者，然后使用灵魂精华容器捕获它们的灵魂。 /  / 将灵魂精华容器和10个野兽灵魂精华交给菲拉斯的巫医尤克里。

tasks.name: 角鹰兽灵魂精华
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill 10 Frayfeather Hippogryphs of any type, then use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture them.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀掉10只任意种类的乱羽角鹰兽，然后用灵魂精华容器捕获它们的灵魂。

tasks.name: 精灵龙灵魂精华
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill 8 Sprite Darters or Sprite Dragons. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Faerie Dragons.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀掉8只精龙或小精龙，然后用灵魂精华容器捕获它们的灵魂。

tasks.name: 树人灵魂精华
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill 3 Wandering Forest Walkers. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Treants.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀掉3个森林漫游者，然后用灵魂精华容器捕获它们的灵魂。

tasks.name: 山岭巨人灵魂精华
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill 7 Land Walkers or Cliff Giants. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Mountain Giants.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀掉7个大地行者或者峭壁巨人，然后用灵魂精华容器捕获它们的灵魂。

tasks.name: 灵魂武器
tasks.objective_text_en: Witch Doctor Uzer'i wants you to wait for a moment while he prepares the weapons.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 巫医尤克里希望你在他准备武器的时候稍等一会儿。

tasks.name: 毒液瓶
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring a Venom Bottle to an apothecary in Tarren Mill.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将毒药瓶交给塔伦米尔的某个药剂师。

tasks.name: 请教加德林大师
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.

tasks.name: 送往幽暗城的毒药
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring Faranell's Parcel to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.

tasks.name: 远古之卵
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Ancient Egg to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将远古之卵交给塔纳利斯的叶基亚。

tasks.name: 打开钥匙之石
tasks.objective_text_en: Find and kill Fozruk. Bring the Rod of Order to the Keystone in the Arathi Highlands.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 找到并杀死弗兹鲁克，然后把秩序魔棒带到阿拉希高地的钥匙之石旁。

tasks.name: 白金圆盘
tasks.objective_text_en: Take the reward voucher to Bena Winterhoof in Thunder Bluff.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把报酬凭证交给雷霆崖的本娜·冰蹄。

tasks.name: 巨魔调和剂
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 20 Vials of Troll Temper to Trenton Lighthammer in Gadgetzan.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 收集20瓶巨魔调和剂，把它们交给加基森的特伦顿·轻锤。

tasks.name: 星，手，心
tasks.english_name: The Star, the Hand and the Heart
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the items on Bel'dugur's Note to Keeper Bel'dugur in the Undercity.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把贝尔杜加的便笺上列出的东西带给幽暗城的看守者贝尔杜加。

tasks.name: 海中的威胁
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill 10 Marsh Murlocs, 10 Marsh Inkspewer, and 10 Marsh Flesheater, then return to Katar in the Swamp of Sorrows.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀掉10个沼泽鱼人、10个沼泽喷墨鱼人和10个沼泽食腐鱼人，然后向悲伤沼泽的卡塔尔回报。

tasks.name: 新鲜的螃蟹腿
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 10 Monstrous Crawler Legs to Dar in the Swamp of Sorrows.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 给悲伤沼泽的达尔带去10条巨大的螃蟹腿。

tasks.name: 铸造火炬杆
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 8 Thorium Plated Daggers to Kalaran Windblade.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 给威拉罗克·温布雷带去8把瑟银匕首。

tasks.name: 烈焰之盒
tasks.objective_text_en: Find and return a Symbol of Ragnaros to Kalaran Windblade.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 找到一个拉格纳罗斯符记，把它交给威拉罗克·温布雷。

tasks.name: 猎龙
tasks.objective_text_en: Hemet Nesingwary Jr. wants you to kill Tethis, an elusive, dangerous raptor in Stranglethorn.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 赫米特·奈辛瓦里二世要求你杀死荆棘谷中最危险最狡猾的迅猛龙泰希斯。

tasks.name: 王牌猎人
tasks.objective_text_en: Hemet Nesingwary Jr. wants you to bring him the head of King Bangalash, the great white tiger.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 赫米特·奈辛瓦里二世要求你将虎王邦加拉什的头带回来给他。

tasks.name: 摩克萨尔丁的魔法
tasks.objective_text_en: Far Seer Mok'thardin of Grom'gol needs Holy Spring Water. He also wants you to kill 10 Naga Explorers.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 格罗姆高营地的先知摩克萨尔丁要你去取回一瓶圣泉之水，同时还要求你杀死10名纳迦探险者。

tasks.name: 歌唱水晶
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 3 Pulsing Blue Shards to Kin'weelay at the Grom'gol Base Camp.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 给格罗姆高营地的肯维雷带回3块蓝色波光碎片。

tasks.name: 一捆海蛇草
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 10 Bundles of Akiris Reed to Privateer Bloads in Booty Bay.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 给藏宝海湾的海盗布劳兹带回10根海蛇草。

tasks.name: 研究石元素
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 5 Bracers of Rock Binding to Lotwil Veriatus in the Badlands.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 收集5个石缚护腕，把它们交给荒芜之地的鲁特维尔·沃拉图斯。

tasks.name: 质量的保证
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 10 Thick Yeti Hides to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 给莫沙彻营地的杉多尔·迅蹄带去十张厚重的雪人皮。

tasks.name: 突然袭击
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill 5 Woodpaw Alphas and return to Hadoken Swiftstrider within one hour.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在1个小时内杀死5个木爪突击队员，并向哈杜肯·迅蹄汇报。

tasks.name: 完好无损的毒囊
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring an Undamaged Venom Sac to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将完好无损的毒囊交给塔伦米尔的药剂师林度恩。

tasks.name: 废土的公正
tasks.objective_text_en: Take down 10 Wastewander Shadow Mages, 8 Wastewander Rogues, and 6 Wastewander Assassins for Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀死10个废土暗法师、8个废土游荡者和6个废土刺客，然后向加基森的总工程师比格维兹报告。

start_entities.name: 首席工程师沙克斯·比格维兹

finish_entities.name: 首席工程师沙克斯·比格维兹

tasks.name: 海盗的帽子！
tasks.objective_text_en: Haughty Modiste wants you to collect 20 Southsea Pirate Hats and return them to her at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 塔纳利斯热砂港的傲慢的店主要你去帮他收集20顶南海海盗帽。

tasks.name: 南海复仇
tasks.objective_text_en: Security Chief Bilgewhizzle of Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris wants you to kill 10 Southsea Pirates, 10 Southsea Freebooters, 10 Southsea Dock Workers and 10 Southsea Swashbucklers.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 塔纳利斯热砂港的安全主管吉罗姆·比格维兹要你去干掉10个南海海盗、10个南海劫掠者、10个南海码头工人和10个南海流氓。

start_entities.name: 安全主管吉罗姆·比格维兹

finish_entities.name: 安全主管吉罗姆·比格维兹

tasks.name: 送回蜜酒
tasks.objective_text_en: Deliver the barrel to Dran Droffers in Orgrimmar.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把桶交给奥格瑞玛的德兰·杜佛斯。

tasks.name: 寻找蜜酒
tasks.objective_text_en: Talk to Malton Droffers in Orgrimmar.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 和奥格瑞玛的玛尔顿·杜佛斯谈一谈。

tasks.name: 寻找蜜酒
tasks.objective_text_en: Talk to Gilveradin Sunchaser; his camp is located in the Hinterlands.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 和基沃拉丁·猎日者谈一谈，他的营地就在辛特兰区域。

tasks.name: 联络中心
tasks.objective_text_en: Oran Snakewrithe in Undercity wants you to travel to the Hinterlands and burn the Highvale Records, Highvale Report, and Highvale Notes.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 幽暗城的奥兰·斯内克威瑟让你到辛特兰去烧毁高原精灵记录、高原精灵报告和高原精灵信件。

tasks.name: 荆棘谷热疫
tasks.objective_text_en: Seek out Witch Doctor Unbagwa and have him summon Mokk the Savage. Bring the Heart of Mokk to Fin Fizracket.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 找到巫医安巴格瓦并要求他召唤出野人莫克，然后将野人莫克的精华交给芬·菲兹拉克。

tasks.name: 瓶中信
tasks.objective_text_en: Find the author of the message in a bottle.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 找到瓶中信的作者。

tasks.name: 讨债行动
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring Maury's Clubbed Foot, Jon-Jon's Golden Spyglass, and Chucky's Huge Ring to "Sea Wolf" MacKinley in Booty Bay.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 给藏宝海湾的"海狼"马克基雷带回玛雷的畸形足、乔乔的金色望远镜和苏克的巨型戒指。

tasks.name: 瓶中信
tasks.objective_text_en: Slay King Mukla and return to Princess Poobah with the Key to free her.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀死穆克拉并带着钥匙回去救出普巴尔公主。

tasks.name: 菲拉斯的食人魔
tasks.objective_text_en: Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache wants you to kill 10 Gordunni Shaman, 10 Gordunni Warlocks, and 5 Gordunni Maulers.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 莫沙彻营地的洛卡·奥赫要你去杀掉十个戈杜尼萨满祭司、10个戈杜尼术士和5个戈杜尼虐待者。

tasks.name: 祖卡什的入侵
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 20 Zukk'ash Carapaces to Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把20块祖卡什虫壳交给菲拉斯莫沙彻营地的哈杜肯·迅蹄。

tasks.name: 收集蜜糖
tasks.objective_text_en: Recover 10 bottles of Hinterlands Honey Ripple from the crates located around the abandoned Horde base in Skulk Rock.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 从隐匿石一带被部落废弃的基地中的箱子里找到10瓶辛特兰蜜糖。

tasks.name: 林吉的秘密
tasks.objective_text_en: Oran Snakewrithe, a well known scholar on matters concerning the Witherbark trolls, may be able to decipher the tablet. She is known to reside within the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 奥兰·斯内克威瑟是个学者，她对枯木巨魔很有研究，也许她可以帮你看看这块石板。奥兰就住在幽暗城的魔法区里。

tasks.name: 托尔贝恩符印
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill Prince Galen Trollbane and bring the Sigil of Trollbane to Zengu in Hammerfall.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀掉加林·托尔贝恩王子，把托尔贝恩符印带给落锤村的森古。

tasks.name: 召唤大地公主
tasks.objective_text_en: Go to the Shards of Myzrael, summon her and defeat her.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 到密斯莱尔水晶碎块去召唤她，然后打败她。 /  / 搜出她身上的怪异镣铐，将其和密斯莱尔水晶碎块缚在一起。

tasks.name: 寻找OOX-17/TN！
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the distress beacon to Oglethorpe's homing robot.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把定位器带到奥格索普的母体机器人那里。

tasks.name: 通缉：安德雷·费尔比德
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring Andre's Head to Security Chief Bilgewhizzle in Steamwheedle Port.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将安德雷的徽记交给热砂港的安全主管吉罗姆·比格维兹。

finish_entities.name: 安全主管吉罗姆·比格维兹

tasks.name: 加兹瑞迪安
tasks.objective_text_en: Marvon Rivetseeker in Tanaris wants you to collect 30 Gahz'ridian Ornaments.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 塔纳利斯的玛尔冯·瑞文斯克要你收集30件加兹瑞迪安饰物。

tasks.name: 海中的威胁
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill 10 Marsh Inkspewers, 10 Marsh Flesheaters, and 10 Marsh Oracles, then return to Katar in the Swamp of Sorrows.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀掉10名沼泽喷墨鱼人、10名沼泽食腐鱼人和10名沼泽鱼人智者，然后向悲伤沼泽的卡塔尔回报。

tasks.name: 被锁起来的矮人
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill 8 Dark Iron Geologists and bring 15 pieces of Silk Cloth to the person locked in the outhouse in Searing Gorge.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀掉8个黑铁地质学家，并将15块丝绸交给灼热峡谷里那个被锁在厕所中的矮人。

tasks.name: 塔纳利斯的账本
tasks.objective_text_en: Take the copy of Goodsteel's Ledger and then find the items listed in it before seeking Krinkle Goodsteel in Tanaris.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把古德斯迪尔的账本和上面所列的物品交给塔纳利斯的克林科·古德斯迪尔。

tasks.name: 自由的钥匙
tasks.objective_text_en: Search Searing Gorge and find a use for the Grimesilt Outhouse Key you have found.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 搜寻灼热峡谷并找到一个可以插入这把格里塞特厕所钥匙的锁眼。

tasks.name: 甘祖拉恩
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill 8 Skullsplitter Hunters, 6 Skullsplitter Headhunters, and 4 Skullsplitter Berserkers.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀死8名劈颅猎人、6名劈颅猎头者和4名劈颅狂战士。 /  / 将安纳希克的盔甲碎片放入格罗姆高营地中的冒泡的大锅里。

tasks.name: 心灵之眼
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Mind's Eye to Kin'weelay at the Grom'gol Base Camp.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将心灵之眼交给格罗姆高营地里的肯维雷。

tasks.name: 不祥的感觉
tasks.english_name: This Is Going to Be Hard
tasks.objective_text_en: Defeat the Fam'retor Guardian and bring Lotwil's Shackles of Elemental Binding back to Lotwil Veriatus.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 击败法姆雷托守护者，并将鲁特维尔的元素禁锢镣铐交还给鲁特维尔。

tasks.name: 黑暗仪式
tasks.objective_text_en: Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache wants you to find a Gordunni Orb.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 莫沙彻营地的洛卡·奥赫希望你找到一颗戈杜尼之宝珠。

tasks.name: 天然材料
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 2 Splintered Logs, 6 Encrusted Minerals, 20 pieces of Resilient Sinew, and 40 Metallic Fragments to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Camp Mojache.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 为莫沙彻营地的巫医尤克里收集2根断裂的原木、6颗包壳矿石、20片有弹性的肌腱和40块金属碎片。

tasks.name: 找到OOX-09/HL！
tasks.objective_text_en: Take the distress beacon to Oglethorpe's homing robot at the head of the river in the Hinterlands, near Skulk Rock.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把定位器带到奥格索普的母体机器人那里去。 /  / 奥格索普的母体机器人位于辛特兰的河水源头，就在隐匿石的附近。

tasks.name: 好味道
tasks.objective_text_en: Marin Noggenfogger wants you to speak with Sprinkle in Gadgetzan.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 马林·诺格弗格让你与加基森的斯普琳科谈一谈。

tasks.name: 斯普琳科的秘密佐料
tasks.objective_text_en: Sprinkle in Gadgetzan wants you to collect a Violet Tragan and return it to her.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 加基森的斯普琳科要你去给她找到一颗紫色水生菇。

tasks.name: 给马林的粉末
tasks.objective_text_en: Sprinkle wants to you take the Violet Powder to Marin Noggenfogger in Gadgetzan.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 斯普琳科让你把紫色粉末交给加基森的马林·诺格弗格。

tasks.name: 诺格弗格药剂
tasks.objective_text_en: Marin Noggenfogger wants you to speak to him again after he creates his elixir.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 马林·诺格弗格让你在他制成药剂之后再去找他。

tasks.name: 加兹瑞拉
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring Gahz'rilla's Electrified Scale to Wizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats.

tasks.name: 通缉：卡利夫·斯科比斯汀
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the head of Caliph Scorpidsting to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将卡利夫·斯科比斯汀的徽记交给加基森的首席工程师沙克斯·比格维兹。

finish_entities.name: 首席工程师沙克斯·比格维兹

tasks.name: 叛徒
tasks.objective_text_en: Deliver the Sealed Letter to Ag'tor Bloodfist in Azshara.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把这封给阿格图的密信交给艾萨拉的阿格图·血拳。

tasks.name: 叛徒
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak to Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与奥格瑞玛的贝尔戈洛姆·石槌谈一谈。

tasks.name: 无瑕之焰
tasks.objective_text_en: Collect 4 Hearts of Flame and 4 globes of Golem Oil and return the items to Kalaran Windblade.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 收集4份烈焰之心和4份傀儡之油，然后把这些东西交给威拉罗克·温布雷。

tasks.name: 更高的品质
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 10 Rage Scar Yeti Hides to Jangdor Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把10块怒痕雪人的毛皮交给菲拉斯莫沙彻营地的杉多尔·迅蹄。

tasks.name: 野蛮的枭兽
tasks.objective_text_en: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 10 Savage Owlbeasts. Return to him once the task is complete.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 辛特兰恶齿村的猎户马克霍尔要求你去杀掉10头野蛮的枭兽。完成任务之后就回到他那里复命。 /  / 马克霍尔说过那些野蛮的枭兽都躲在辛特兰的野外。

tasks.name: 邪枝窃贼
tasks.objective_text_en: Smith Slagtree at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to find Slagtree's Lost Tools. Return to him once this task is complete.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 辛特兰恶齿村的铁匠斯拉提要你去找到斯拉提的工具。完成任务之后就回到他那里去。 /  / 你记得铁匠斯拉提说过，你可以在辛特兰东北部的某个邪枝巨魔神庙中找到它，要不然就是在隐匿石那边。

tasks.name: 给蛮锤部族的警告
tasks.objective_text_en: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to slaughter 8 Highvale Scouts, 5 Highvale Outrunners, 5 Highvale Rangers and 2 Highvale Marksman. Return to him when this task is complete.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 辛特兰恶齿村的奥索·莫吉克要你去杀掉8个高原前锋、5个高原斥候和2个高原神射手。任务完成之后回到他那里去复命。 /  / 你可以在辛特兰西北部的奎尔丹尼小屋找到那些高原精灵。

tasks.name: 又一个给蛮锤部族的警告
tasks.objective_text_en: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to bring him 1 Long Elegant Feather from the gryphons that inhabit the Hinterlands. Return to him once this task is complete.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 辛特兰恶齿村的奥索·莫吉克要你从辛特兰的狮鹫身上收集1根细长的狮鹫羽毛。任务完成之后回到他那里去复命。 /  / 在辛特兰各处都有狮鹫出没。

tasks.name: 野蛮的亲戚
tasks.objective_text_en: Mystic Yayo'jin at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 6 Vilebranch Scalpers and 2 Vilebranch Soothsayers. Return to her when this task is complete.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 辛特兰恶齿村的秘法师雅尔金要你去杀掉6个邪枝割颅者和2个邪枝占卜者。任务完成之后回到他那里去复命。 /  / 秘法师雅尔金说过，你可以在辛特兰东北部的沙尔瓦萨和亚戈瓦萨神庙附近找到那些巨魔。

tasks.name: 腐化之巢
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring five Centipaar insect parts from the Noxious Lair to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 从腐化之巢找5个森提帕尔昆虫肢体，把它们交给加基森的炼金师匹斯特苏格。

tasks.name: 口渴的地精
tasks.objective_text_en: Collect a Laden Dew Gland and bring it to Marin Noggenfogger in Gadgetzan.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 找到1个饱满的露水腺，把它交给加基森的马林·诺格弗格。

tasks.name: 堕落之水
tasks.objective_text_en: Fill all 4 Empty Vials at the tide pools along the coast of the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara before returning to Chemist Cuely.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在艾萨拉的埃达拉斯废墟旁的海潮之池中收集4瓶水，然后回到药剂师科雷那儿。

tasks.name: 堕落之水
tasks.objective_text_en: Give Cuely's Elixir to Thersa Windsong in Undercity.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将科雷的药剂交给幽暗城的瑟尔萨·风歌。

tasks.name: 丢失的命令
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak to Bengor at Stonard in Swamp of Sorrows.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与悲伤沼泽中斯通纳德的本戈尔谈一谈。

tasks.name: 看看它的个头！
tasks.english_name: Look at the Size of It!
tasks.objective_text_en: Take Chambermaid Pillaclencher's Pillow to Evonice Sootsmoker in the Searing Gorge.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将比拉凯琳的枕头交给灼热峡谷的艾沃奈斯。

tasks.name: 绝密配方！
tasks.objective_text_en: Somewhere in the Slag Pit of the Cauldron you will find the Secret Plans: Fiery Flux that Overseer Maltorius stole. Find those plans and return them to Master Smith Burninate in the Searing Gorge.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在大熔炉的熔渣之池中的某个地方，你可以找到工头玛托留斯偷走的秘密设计图：炽热助熔剂。找到这些设计图，把它们还给灼热峡谷的大铁匠博恩奈特。

tasks.name: 被盗：鼓风机和望远镜
tasks.english_name: STOLEN: Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass
tasks.objective_text_en: Find and return the Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass to Taskmaster Scrange in the Searing Gorge.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 找到冶炼鼓风机和侦查员的望远镜，把它们还给灼热峡谷的监工斯克兰格。 /  / 你所知道的关于这些物品的惟一信息是：它们肯定是被黑铁矮人偷走的。冶炼鼓风机是铁匠用的锻造工具，侦查员的望远镜是侦查员所需的侦查工具。

tasks.name: 工作机会：肃清竞争对手
tasks.objective_text_en: Slay 15 Dark Iron Taskmasters and 15 Dark Iron Slavers. Return to Taskmaster Scrange in the Searing Gorge once you have accomplished this task.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀死15个黑铁工头和15个黑铁奴隶贩子。完成任务之后就回去找监工斯克兰格。

tasks.name: 会见主人
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 2 Undamaged Hippogryph Feathers to Sanath Lim-yo in Azshara if you wish to speak to his master.

tasks.name: 破坏结界
tasks.objective_text_en: Wait for Loramus to complete the enlightenment spell.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 等待洛拉姆斯完成启迪法术。

tasks.name: 恶魔之名
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Lord Arkkoroc in Azshara. Begin your search at the waters edge to find the Temple of Arkkoran.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与艾萨拉的亚考罗克谈一谈。你应该在海边搜索亚考兰神殿。

tasks.name: 恶魔之名
tasks.objective_text_en: Take the temper back to Loramus Thalipedes.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将调剂交给洛拉姆斯·萨里比迪斯。

tasks.name: 搜索知识
tasks.objective_text_en: Find the Tablet of Beth'Amara, the Tablet of Jin'yael, the Tablet of Markri, and the Tablet of Sael'hai before returning to Jediga in Azshara.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 找到贝萨玛拉石板、辛耶尔石板、玛科里石板和塞尔哈石板，把它们交给艾萨拉的杰迪加。

tasks.name: 玛加萨的石版
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Tablet of Beth'Amara to Magatha in Thunder Bluff.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将贝萨玛拉石板交给雷霆崖的玛加萨·野性图腾。

tasks.name: 杰斯雷蒙的石版
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Tablet of Jin'yael to Jes'rimon in Orgrimmar.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将辛耶尔石板交给奥格瑞玛的杰斯雷蒙。

tasks.name: 安德隆·甘特的石版
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Tablet of Markri to Andron Gant in Undercity.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将玛科里石板交给幽暗城的安德隆·甘特。

tasks.name: 大法师克希雷姆的石版
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Tablet of Sael'hai to Archmage Xylem in Azshara.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将塞尔哈石板交给艾萨拉的大法师克希雷姆。

tasks.name: 玛加萨的报酬
tasks.objective_text_en: Deliver Magatha's Note to Jediga in Azshara.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将玛加萨的便笺交给艾萨拉的杰迪加。

tasks.name: 杰斯雷蒙的报酬
tasks.objective_text_en: Deliver Jes'rimon's Note to Jediga in Azshara.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将杰斯雷蒙的便笺交给艾萨拉的杰迪加。

tasks.name: 安德隆的报酬
tasks.objective_text_en: Deliver Andron's Note to Jediga in Azshara.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将安德隆的便笺交给艾萨拉的杰迪加。

tasks.name: 克希雷姆的报酬
tasks.objective_text_en: Deliver Xylem's Note to Jediga in Azshara.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将克希雷姆的便笺交给艾萨拉的杰迪加。

tasks.name: 艾萨拉水晶
tasks.objective_text_en: Recover twenty Crystallized Azsharite from southern Azshara. You may use the Felhound to assist you in 'sniffing' out the location of cleverly hidden deposits.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在艾萨拉南部收集20块艾萨拉晶体。你可以使用地狱犬协助寻找一些隐藏的矿脉。 /  / 任务完成之后就回到洛拉姆斯那里去。

tasks.name: 武器的铸造
tasks.objective_text_en: Take the Shipment to Galvan the Ancient in Stranglethorn Vale.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把货物交给荆棘谷的加尔文。

tasks.name: 永不安息的灵魂
tasks.objective_text_en: Destroy 6 Highborne Apparitions and 6 Highborne Lichlings before returning to Loh'atu in Azshara.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀掉6个上层精灵的幻影和6个上层精灵鬼巫，然后向艾萨拉的罗哈图复命。

tasks.name: 充满仇恨的土地
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill 6 Haldarr Satyr, 2 Haldarr Tricksters, 2 Haldarr Felsworn and then return to Loh'atu on the border of Ashenvale.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀掉6个哈达尔萨特、2个哈达尔欺诈者和2个哈达尔魔仆，然后向灰谷与艾萨拉交界处的罗哈图复命。

tasks.name: 返回诅咒之地
tasks.objective_text_en: Return to the Fallen Hero of the Horde at Splinterspear Junction in Swamp of Sorrows.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 回到悲伤沼泽中断矛路口的部落英雄的灵魂那里。

tasks.name: 被缩小的巨人
tasks.objective_text_en: Use Zorbin's Ultra-Shrinker to zap any kind of giant found in Feralas into a more manageable form. Bring 15 Miniaturization Residues found on the zapped versions of these giants to Zorbin Fandazzle at the docks of the Forgotten Coast, Feralas.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 使用索尔宾的超级压缩器来缩小菲拉斯的任意种类的巨人，将他们缩小到更容易控制的体积。从缩小过的巨人身上收集15份微缩残渣，把它们交给菲拉斯被遗忘的海岸码头的索尔宾-范达瑟。

tasks.name: 压缩器的动力
tasks.objective_text_en: Collect 10 Water Elemental Cores from the Sea Elementals and Sea Sprays along the Forgotten Coast of Feralas, and bring them back to Zorbin Fandazzle who is near the dock there.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 从菲拉斯被遗忘的海岸那里的海元素和巨型海元素身上获取10块水元素核心，把它们交给码头附近的索尔宾·范达瑟。

tasks.name: 毒刺鞭笞者
tasks.objective_text_en: Defeat Stinglasher in the Writhing Deep, bringing its glands back to Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 击败痛苦深渊中的毒刺鞭笞者，把它的腺体交给菲拉斯莫沙彻营地的哈杜肯·迅蹄。

tasks.name: 为库米沙效力
tasks.objective_text_en: In your journeys throughout the Blasted Lands, should you ever come across a Flawless Draenethyst Sphere, take the item back to Kum'isha the Collector.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在你探索诅咒之地的旅程中，如果碰巧发现了无瑕的德莱尼水晶球，就把它交给收藏家库米沙。 /  / 你要知道，这种宝石是整个艾泽拉斯最珍稀的水晶。诅咒之地上的任何一种生物都有可能带着一颗无瑕的德莱尼水晶球。 /  / 每找到一颗，你都会得到相应的酬劳。

tasks.name: 石化蜥蜴的大脑
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring ten Basilisk Brains and two Vulture Gizzards to Bloodmage Lynnore.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 收集10颗石化蜥蜴的大脑和2个秃鹫的砂囊，把它们交给血法师莱诺雷。

tasks.name: 秃鹫的活力
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring ten Vulture Gizzards and two Snickerfang Jowls to Bloodmage Lynnore.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 收集10个秃鹫的砂囊和2块弯牙土狼的颚骨，把它们交给血法师莱诺雷。

tasks.name: 悔恨的战士
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak to Dispatch Commander Ruag at Stonard in Swamp of Sorrows.

tasks.name: 古代英雄
tasks.objective_text_en: Open the chest and claim your reward.

tasks.name: 古代英雄
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak to Corporal Thund Splithoof.

tasks.name: 基利斯
tasks.objective_text_en: Find out what became of Lieutenant Kirith.

tasks.name: 黑暗笼罩
tasks.objective_text_en: Return to the Fallen Hero of the Horde with your findings.

tasks.name: 多多益善
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring Kum'isha Imperfect Draenethyst Fragments and be rewarded for each one you turn in.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将有瑕疵的德莱尼水晶碎片交给库米沙，你就可以得到相应的回报。

tasks.name: 与纳菲恩交谈
tasks.objective_text_en: Travel north along the main road in Felwood and speak with the furbolg named Nafien. He stands guard outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 沿着费伍德森林的路向北走，与一个名叫纳菲恩的熊怪谈谈。他站在木喉要塞的入口处。

tasks.name: 冬泉熊怪的活动
tasks.objective_text_en: Salfa wants you to kill 8 Winterfall Shaman, 8 Winterfall Den Watchers, and 8 Winterfall Ursa. Salfa is located just outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold in Winterspring.

tasks.name: 与萨尔法交谈
tasks.objective_text_en: Travel through Timbermaw Hold and exit into Winterspring. Speak with Salfa, who stands guard outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 穿过木喉要塞去冬泉谷。和萨尔法谈谈，他就在木喉要塞另一头的出口处。

tasks.name: 钳嘴龟！
tasks.objective_text_en: Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 10 Saltwater Snapjaw turtles. Return to him when you have completed this task.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 辛特兰恶齿村的钓鱼者卡图姆要你去杀掉10只海水钳嘴龟。完成任务之后回到他那里去复命。

tasks.name: 银鬃捕猎者
tasks.objective_text_en: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 5 Silvermane Stalkers and 5 Silvermane Howlers. Return to him once the task is complete.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 辛特兰恶齿村的猎户马克霍尔要求你去杀掉5头银鬃捕猎者和5头银鬃嗥狼。完成任务之后就回到他那里复命。 /  / 马克霍尔说过那些狼都躲在辛特兰的野外。

tasks.name: 死者的复仇
tasks.objective_text_en: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill a Razorbeak Skylord and retrieve its Skylord Plume. Return to him once the task is complete.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 辛特兰恶齿村的猎户马克霍尔要求你杀掉一头翱翔的锋喙狮鹫，并将它的狮鹫长羽拿回去交给他。 /  / 马克霍尔说过那些翱翔的锋喙狮鹫就躲在辛特兰的野外。

tasks.name: 奥丹姆的线索
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Nara Wildmane on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与雷霆崖长者高地的纳拉·蛮鬃谈一谈。

tasks.name: 拭目以待
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the miniature platinum discs to the gates of Uldum in Tanaris and look for clues as to the connection between the two.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将迷你白金圆盘拿到塔纳利斯的奥丹姆大门去，找出两者之间的联系。

tasks.name: 返回雷霆崖
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与雷霆崖的纳拉·蛮鬃谈一谈。

tasks.name: 进一步的任务
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Sage Truthseeker in Thunder Bluff.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与雷霆崖的圣者图希克谈一谈。

tasks.name: 阿塔哈卡神庙
tasks.objective_text_en: Collect 20 Fetishes of Hakkar and bring them to Fel'Zerul in Stonard.

sources.name: 阿塔莱死亡行者的灵魂

tasks.name: 沉没的神庙
tasks.objective_text_en: Find Marvon Rivetseeker in Tanaris.

tasks.name: 深入神庙
tasks.objective_text_en: Find the Altar of Hakkar in the Sunken Temple in Swamp of Sorrows.

tasks.name: 雕像群的秘密
tasks.objective_text_en: Travel into the Sunken Temple and discover the secret hidden in the circle of statues.

tasks.name: 石环
tasks.objective_text_en: Retrieve the Stone Circle from Marvon Rivetseeker's workshop in Ratchet.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 到棘齿城去，从玛尔冯·瑞文斯克的车间里取回石环。

tasks.name: 该死的手指头！
tasks.objective_text_en: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Heavy War Golems.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 汉瑟尔·重拳让你杀掉20个重型作战傀儡。 /  / 重型作战傀儡就在灼热峡谷的大熔炉附近。当你杀死足够多的傀儡后，就回去找汉瑟尔·重拳。

tasks.name: 熔岩蜘蛛的威胁！
tasks.objective_text_en: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Greater Lava Spiders in the Searing Gorge. You can find Greater Lava Spiders in the plateaus and lava pools of the Searing Gorge.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 汉瑟尔·重拳要你杀死灼热峡谷中的20只巨型熔岩蜘蛛。你可以在灼热峡谷的高地和熔岩池里找到巨型熔岩蜘蛛。 /  / 当你杀死足够的巨型熔岩蜘蛛之后，回到汉瑟尔·重拳那里复命。

tasks.name: 熏火龙
tasks.english_name: Incendosaurs? Whateverosaur is More Like It
tasks.objective_text_en: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Incendosaurs.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 汉瑟尔·重拳让你去杀掉20个熏火龙。 /  / 熏火龙侵占了熔渣之池中的那些岩浆池。熔渣之池就在灼热峡谷的大熔炉中。 /  / 当你杀死足够数量的熏火龙后，就回去找汉瑟尔·重拳。

sources.name: 铁炉堡公主茉艾拉·铜须

tasks.name: 弯牙土狼的颚骨
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring three Snickerfang Jowls, two Blasted Boar Lungs, and one Scorpok Pincer to Bloodmage Drazial.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 收集3个弯牙土狼的颚骨、2片诅咒之地的野猪肺和1个厚甲蝎螯，把它们交给血法师德拉吉亚。

tasks.name: 野猪的活力
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring three Blasted Boar Lungs, two Scorpok Pincers, and one Basilisk Brain to Bloodmage Drazial.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 收集3片诅咒之地的野猪肺、2个厚甲蝎螯和1颗石化蜥蜴的大脑，把它们交给血法师德拉吉亚。

tasks.name: 决定性的打击
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring three Scorpok Pincers, two Vulture Gizzards, and one Blasted Boar Lung to Bloodmage Drazial.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 收集3个厚甲蝎螯、2个秃鹫的砂囊和1片诅咒之地的野猪肺，把它们血法师德拉吉亚。

tasks.name: 加莫里塔！
tasks.objective_text_en: Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill Gammerita and retrieve Katoom's Best Lure from her corpse.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 辛特兰恶齿村的钓鱼者卡图姆要你去杀掉加莫里塔，并从它的尸体上找到卡图姆的超级鱼饵。 /  / 卡图姆说加莫里塔和其它海龟都在海岸附近活动。

tasks.name: 被绑架的断齿长者！
tasks.objective_text_en: Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to rescue her mate, Elder Torntusk, from Jintha'alor.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 辛特兰恶齿村的断齿族长要求你到辛萨罗去拯救她的爱人，断齿长者。 /  / 你听说他被关在辛萨罗顶部，辛萨罗位于辛特兰的南部地区，那里是邪枝巨魔的主城。

tasks.name: 向断齿族长复命
tasks.objective_text_en: Elder Torntusk at Jintha'alor wants you to return to Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village with news of his rescue.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 辛萨罗的断齿长者要求你将他已经被营救的消息带给恶齿村的断齿族长。

tasks.name: 分离的痛苦
tasks.objective_text_en: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to recover his twin brother's remains. Find and return Huntsman Malkhor's Skull and Huntsman Malkhor's Bones to Huntsman Markhor.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 辛特兰恶齿村的猎户马克霍尔要你去找回他的双胞胎兄弟的尸体。找到它，然后把猎户莫克霍尔的徽记和猎户莫克霍尔的骨头交给猎户马克霍尔。 /  / 马克霍尔说过，他兄弟的尸体被软泥怪和邪枝巨魔的狼群分食。他还提到在辛萨罗有个大坑，里面全都是软泥怪，那里还有个狼穴。这两个地方都在靠近辛萨罗神庙顶部的区域。

tasks.name: 黑暗之瓶
tasks.objective_text_en: Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to recover 5 Vessels of Tainted Blood from Jintha'alor. Return to Primal Torntusk when this task is complete.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 辛特兰恶齿村的断齿族长要你在辛萨罗找到5瓶腐化之血。任务完成之后就回到断齿族长那里。

tasks.name: 除草器的燃料
tasks.objective_text_en: Deliver the Unloaded Zapper and 5 samples of Atal'ai Haze to Larion in Marshal's Refuge.

tasks.name: 灌木谷
tasks.objective_text_en: Tran'rek in Gadgetzan wants you to kill 8 Gnarled Thistleshrubs and 8 Thistleshrub Rootshapers.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 加基森的特兰雷克要你杀掉8只长瘤的灌木兽和8只灌木塑根者。

tasks.name: 砂槌食人魔
tasks.objective_text_en: Andi Lynn in Gadgetzan wants you to destroy the Dunemaul Compound by killing 10 Dunemaul Brutes, 10 Dunemaul Enforcers, and Gor'marok the Ravager.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 加基森的安迪·利恩想要你攻入砂槌营地，杀死10个砂槌蛮兵、10个砂槌执行者，以及掠夺者格玛洛克。

tasks.name: 协助大德鲁伊
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与雷霆崖的大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾谈一谈。

finish_entities.name: 大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾

tasks.name: 无人知晓的秘密
tasks.objective_text_en: Look around in the pond for a clue about who this wrecked raft may belong to.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在池塘附近查找与搁浅的小艇有关的线索。

tasks.name: 无人知晓的秘密
tasks.objective_text_en: Examine the items inside the pack and bring them to their owner.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 查看袋子里的东西，然后将它们交给物主。

tasks.name: 无人知晓的秘密
tasks.objective_text_en: Take Linken's Sword to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把林克的剑交给冬泉谷的多诺瓦·雪山。

tasks.name: 视灵药剂
tasks.objective_text_en: Seek out Gregan Brewspewer in northern Feralas. From him, learn how you may acquire the Videre Elixir, then return to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

tasks.name: 墓地相见
tasks.objective_text_en: Go to the graveyard outside Gadgetzan, and use the Videre Elixir. Follow the rest of Donova's instructions to find Gaeriyan.

tasks.name: 寻找墓碑
tasks.objective_text_en: Resurrect, then look for the gravestone that Gaeriyan told you to find.

tasks.name: 林克的剑
tasks.objective_text_en: Deliver Linken's Superior Sword to Linken in Un'Goro Crater.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把林克的强化之剑交给安戈洛尔环形山的林克。

tasks.name: 侏儒的援助
tasks.objective_text_en: Find J.D. Collie in the cave at Marshal's Refuge.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 到马绍尔营地那里的山洞中去找科琳。

tasks.name: 林克的记忆
tasks.objective_text_en: Find Eridan Bluewind in southern Felwood.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 到费伍德森林去找艾瑞丹·蓝风。

tasks.name: 林克的冒险
tasks.objective_text_en: Take the Silver Totem of Aquementas to Linken in Marshal's Refuge.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把亚奎门塔斯的银图腾交给马绍尔营地里的林克。

tasks.name: 亚奎门塔斯
tasks.objective_text_en: Take the Book of Aquor, the Silvery Claws, and the Irontree Heart to Tanaris.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把阿奎尔之书、银爪和铁树之心带到塔纳利斯去。 /  / 使用这本书召唤亚奎门塔斯。 /  / 在图腾完成之后，把它交给马绍尔营地的科琳。

tasks.name: 银爪铁心
tasks.objective_text_en: Collect 11 Silvery Claws and 1 Irontree Heart for Eridan Bluewind in Felwood.

tasks.name: 玛尔冯的车间
tasks.objective_text_en: Travel to Marvon Rivetseeker's workshop in Ratchet.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 到棘齿城去，在玛尔冯·瑞文斯克的车间里找到他。

tasks.name: 能量水晶
tasks.objective_text_en: Collect 7 Power Crystals of each color: red, blue, yellow, and green. Bring them to J.D. Collie at Marshal's Refuge.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 收集红色能量水晶、蓝色能量水晶、黄色能量水晶和绿色能量水晶各7块，把它们交给马绍尔营地里的科琳。

tasks.name: 协助大德鲁伊
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与雷霆崖的大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾谈一谈。

finish_entities.name: 大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾

tasks.name: 我就是基姆加尔！
tasks.objective_text_en: Search the Thalassian Base Camp for Kim'jael's Compass, Scope, Stuffed Chicken and Wizzlegoober, then return them to him in Azshara.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 搜索萨拉斯营地，找到基姆加尔的指南针、望远镜、烧鸡和花生，然后把它们交给艾萨拉的基姆加尔。

tasks.name: 对鹰身人的复仇
tasks.objective_text_en: Talo Thornhoof wants you to kill 4 Northspring Harpies, 4 Northspring Roguefeathers, 4 Northspring Windcallers, and 4 Northspring Slayers.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 塔罗·刺蹄让你杀掉4个北泉鹰身人、4个北泉游荡者、4个北泉唤风者和4个北泉杀戮者。

tasks.name: 堕落的力量
tasks.objective_text_en: Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas wants you to kill 12 Angerclaw Grizzlies and 12 Felpaw Ravagers in Felwood.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 菲拉斯莫沙彻营地的塔罗·刺蹄要你去费伍德森林杀掉12头怒爪灰熊和12头魔爪掠夺者。

tasks.name: 木喉熊怪的盟友
tasks.objective_text_en: Grazle wants you to prove yourself by killing 6 Deadwood Warriors, 6 Deadwood Pathfinders, and 6 Deadwood Gardeners. Return to him in southern Felwood near the Emerald Sanctuary when you are done.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 格拉兹要你去杀死6个死木战士、6个死木探路者以及6个死木园丁。

tasks.name: 拉尔德的午餐
tasks.objective_text_en: Lard at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to find Lard's Lunch. Return to him when this task is complete.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 辛特兰恶齿村的拉尔德要求你去找到拉尔德的午餐。完成任务之后就回到他那里去。 /  / 拉尔德说他把午餐留在了北面的岛上。当心邪枝巨魔。

tasks.name: 职位空缺：恶齿村卫兵队长
tasks.english_name: Job Opening: Guard Captain of Revantusk Village
tasks.objective_text_en: You have been tasked with the decimation of 5 Vilebranch Berserkers, 3 Vilebranch Shadow Hunters, 3 Vilebranch Blood Drinkers, and 2 Vilebranch Soul Eaters.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 你必须消灭5个邪枝狂战士、3个邪枝暗影猎手、3个邪枝饮血者和3个邪枝噬魂者。 /  / 完成任务之后向辛特兰恶齿村的断齿族长复命。

tasks.name: 协助大德鲁伊
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与雷霆崖的大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾谈一谈。

finish_entities.name: 大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾

tasks.name: 晨光麦研究
tasks.objective_text_en: Take the Seed Voucher to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将草种购买券交给雷霆崖的巴珊娜·符文图腾。

start_entities.name: 大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾

tasks.name: 晨光麦研究
tasks.objective_text_en: Use an Evergreen Pouch with a Packet of Tharlendis Seeds and two Un'Goro Soil samples to try and cultivate samples of Morrowgrain.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 用一个常青袋、一包萨伦迪斯种子以及两份安戈洛的泥土来尝试种植晨光麦。 /  / 将10株晨光麦交给雷霆崖的巴珊娜·符文图腾。

tasks.name: 伊兰尼库斯精华
tasks.objective_text_en: Place the Essence of Eranikus in the Essence Font located in this lair in the Sunken Temple.

tasks.name: 瘟疫与你
tasks.objective_text_en: Use the Empty Termite Jar on the Termite Mounds in Eastern Plaguelands. After you've gathered 100 Plagueland Termites, return to Mickey Levine at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在东瘟疫之地的蚁丘上使用空的白蚁瓶。当你收集了100只瘟疫白蚁之后，就回到提瑞斯法林地的亡灵壁垒去找米克·莱文。

tasks.name: 尖啸者的灵魂
tasks.objective_text_en: Capture the spirits of 3 screechers in Feralas, then return to Yeh'kinya in Steamwheedle Port.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在菲拉斯捕获3个尖啸者的灵魂，然后回到热砂港的叶基亚那里去。

tasks.name: 极度粘稠的沥青
tasks.objective_text_en: Collect 12 samples of Super Sticky Tar for Tran'rek in Gadgetzan.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 帮加基森的特兰雷克收集12块极度粘稠的沥青。

tasks.name: 骨刃武器
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 8 White Ravasaur Claws to Jes'rimon in Orgrimmar.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将8只白色暴掠龙爪交给奥格瑞玛的杰斯雷蒙。

tasks.name: 抢救物资
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring a Crate of Foodstuffs and Research Equipment to Williden Marshal in Un'Goro Crater.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将食物箱和研究设备交给安戈洛环形山的威利德·马绍尔。

tasks.name: 异型的生态
tasks.objective_text_en: Use the Scraping Vial to collect a Hive Wall Sample from one of the Gorishi hive hatcheries in Un'Goro Crater. Look for the chambers with the hanging larval spawns.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 使用采集瓶从安戈洛环形山的某个格里什虫巢的孵化室中收集一份巢穴侧壁的样本，在有悬挂着的虫卵的房间里收集样本。 /  / 将虫穴内壁样本交给安戈洛环形山的霍莱伊·马绍尔。

tasks.name: 威利德的日记
tasks.objective_text_en: Return the journal to Williden Marshal somewhere in Un'Goro Crater.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将日记还给安戈洛环形山中的威利德·马绍尔。

tasks.name: 找回A-Me 01
tasks.objective_text_en: Find A-Me 01 in Un'Goro Crater.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在安戈洛环形山找到A-Me 01。

tasks.name: 拉克维的食物
tasks.objective_text_en: Find the carcass of Lar'korwi's freshest kill and steal a Piece of Threshadon Carcass before returning to Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 找到拉克维刚刚猎杀的动物的尸体，从尸体上偷取一块蛇颈龙肉块，然后回到安戈洛环形山的托尔瓦·寻路者那里。

tasks.name: 拉克维的气味
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 2 Ravasaur Pheromone Glands to Torwa Pathfinder near the entrance to Un'Goro Crater.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将2份暴掠龙信息素交给安戈洛尔环形山入口附近的托尔瓦·寻路者。

tasks.name: 毒药的免疫力
tasks.objective_text_en: Mor'vek in Un'goro Crater claims that if you were poisoned by Venomhide Ravasaur blood 20 times, you could ride one without dying. Attack Venomhide Ravasaurs for a chance to be poisoned.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 安戈洛环形山的莫维克说，如果你能被毒皮暴掠龙的血染上20次毒，就可以安全地骑它了。攻击毒皮魔暴龙，有一定几率会中毒。

tasks.name: 毒皮暴掠龙蛋
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 4 Venomhide Ravasaur Eggs to Mor'vek in the southeast part of the Marshlands.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把4枚毒皮暴掠龙蛋带给位于沼泽地东南的莫维克。

tasks.name: 飞速成长
tasks.objective_text_en: Return 20 Venomhide Baby Teeth, the Venomhide Hatchling, 20 Runecloth, 20 Rugged Leather, and 80 gold to Mor'vek in the southeastern part of the Marshlands in Un'Goro Crater.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将20枚毒皮暴掠幼龙牙齿、你的毒皮暴掠龙幼崽，还有20块符文布、20块硬甲皮和80金币交给位于安戈洛环形山沼泽地东南的莫维克。

tasks.name: 软泥怪的样本...
tasks.objective_text_en: Gather Felwood Slime Samples from any of the slimes in Felwood. Then, using the Testing Equipment next to Chemist Fuely in Undercity, see which of your samples are the most corrupt. Bring 5 of the Corrupted Felwood Samples you find to Chemist Fuely.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 从费伍德的软泥怪身上收集费伍德软泥怪样本，然后使用幽暗城的化学家弗雷身旁的测试设备来检测你所收集的样本中哪一份被腐化的程度最深。给化学家弗雷带去5个被腐化的费伍德样本。

tasks.name: 一大堆软泥怪
tasks.objective_text_en: Gather Un'Goro Slime Samples from any of the slimes in Un'Goro Crater. Then, using the Testing Equipment next to Chemist Fuely in Undercity, see which of your samples are the most pure. Bring 5 of the Pure Un'Goro Samples you find to Chemist Fuely.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 从安戈洛尔环形山那里任何泥浆怪身上收集安戈洛泥浆怪样本。使用幽暗城的化学家弗雷身旁的测试仪器来检验你所采集到的样本的纯度。把5份纯净的安戈洛样本送到化学家弗雷那里去。

tasks.name: 沼泽空谈者
tasks.objective_text_en: Retrieve the Warchief's Orders and return them to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 取回酋长的命令，把它们还给部落英雄的灵魂。

tasks.name: 伊兰尼库斯精华
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Oathstone of Ysera's Dragonflight and the Chained Essence of Eranikus to Itharius in the Swamp of Sorrows. It is there that you will make your choice to aid Ysera's Dragonflight or not.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把伊瑟拉巨龙军团的誓言石和被禁锢的伊兰尼库斯精华交给悲伤沼泽的伊萨里奥斯。在那里你可以决定是否要帮助伊瑟拉的绿龙军团。

tasks.name: 帮助伊兰尼库斯
tasks.objective_text_en: Travel to the eastern part of Winterspring and speak with Umbranse the Spiritspeaker.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 到冬泉谷的东部地区去，与灵语者阿姆布兰希谈一谈。

tasks.name: 瘟疫与你
tasks.objective_text_en: Find someplace suitable in the center of the Northridge Lumber Mill in Western Plaguelands to place the Barrel of Plagueland Termites.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 到西瘟疫之地的北山伐木场去找个合适的地方，在那里放下一桶瘟疫白蚁。

tasks.name: 悬赏：工头玛托留斯
tasks.objective_text_en: Deep within the Slag Pit of the Cauldron, in the Searing Gorge, you will find the traitorous Dark Iron dwarf named Overseer Maltorius.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 那个叫做工头玛托留斯的黑铁矮人叛徒就藏在大熔炉的熔渣之池深处。 /  / 杀死工头玛托留斯，将他的徽记交给灼热峡谷的侦查队长洛洛尔以换取你的奖励。

tasks.name: 基姆加尔"丢失"的装备
tasks.objective_text_en: Find Some Rune that the naga have in their possession in the Ruins of Eldarath and return it to Kim'jael in Azshara.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 寻找埃达拉斯废墟中的纳迦携带的那些符石，然后把它们交给艾萨拉的基姆加尔。

tasks.name: 破碎的联盟
tasks.objective_text_en: Use the Sign of the Earth to activate the Pillars of Diamond, Opal, and Amethyst and obtain the Runestones.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 用大地印章激活钻石柱、玛瑙石柱和紫水晶石柱并拿到三颗符石。 /  / 把符石放在大地封印上，释放黑龙布莱克拉什和赫玛图斯。 /  / 杀了这两条黑龙，把黑龙布莱克拉什的锁链、赫玛图斯的锁链和大地印章交给高恩。

tasks.name: 巨槌石
tasks.objective_text_en: Venture forth to the Burning Steppes and find out what became of Sha'ni Proudtusk.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 到燃烧平原去找到沙妮·长齿。

tasks.name: 黑暗之心
tasks.objective_text_en: Talo Thornhoof in Camp Mojache wants Edana Hatetalon's Dark Heart.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 莫沙彻营地的塔罗·刺蹄要你给他拿去艾丹娜·邪爪的黑心。

tasks.name: 瘟疫与你
tasks.objective_text_en: Release the Plagueland Termites in the Northridge Lumber Mill, then return with the Barrel of Plagueland Termites to Mickey Levine at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 使用北山伐木场里的铁棍放出那里的瘟疫白蚁，然后向提瑞斯法林地亡灵壁垒的米克·莱文报告。

tasks.name: 收集堕落之水
tasks.objective_text_en: Take the Empty Canteen to the Moon Well in the center of Jaedenar and fill it before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把空壶拿到加德纳尔中心的月亮井去，装满井水之后再回到费伍德森林的格雷塔·苔蹄那里。

tasks.name: 水之魂的帮助
tasks.objective_text_en: Take the Corrupt Moon Well Water to Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把腐化的月亮井水交给贫瘠之地的水之先知伊斯伦。

tasks.name: 净化过的水
tasks.objective_text_en: Take the Purified Moon Well Water to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把净化过的月亮井水交给费伍德森林的格雷塔·苔蹄。

tasks.name: 熄灭火焰
tasks.objective_text_en: Using the Purified Moon Well Water, douse the flames of the four braziers of protection within Shadow Hold in Felwood, then return to Greta Mosshoof in the Emerald Sanctuary.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 使用净化过的月亮井水熄灭暗影堡内部的四座火盆的火焰，从而破除其保护效果，然后向翡翠圣地的格雷塔·苔蹄复命。

tasks.name: 安戈洛的泥土
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 20 Un'Goro Soil samples to Ghede on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 收集20份安戈洛的泥土，把它们交给雷霆崖的格德。

start_entities.name: 大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾

tasks.name: 奇怪的家伙
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Winna Hazzard in Felwood.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与费伍德森林的温娜·哈萨德谈一谈。

tasks.name: 挖骨头
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 8 Dinosaur Bones to Spark Nilminer in Un'Goro Crater.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将8根恐龙骨头交给安戈洛环形山的斯巴克·尼米尔。

tasks.name: 希兹尔的飞行器
tasks.objective_text_en: Collect 8 Webbed Diemetradon Scales and 8 Webbed Pterrordax Scales for Shizzle in Marshal's Refuge.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 为马绍尔营地的希兹尔收集8块精细的双帆龙鳞片和8块精细的翼手龙鳞片。

tasks.name: 融合软泥怪
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring a Merged Ooze Sample to Chemist Fuely in Undercity.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把一块融合的软泥怪样本交给幽暗城的化学家弗雷。

tasks.name: 腐化之井
tasks.objective_text_en: Collect a sample of corrupted water from the Jadefire Satyrs' moonwell and bring it to Winna Hazzard at Bloodvenom Post.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 从碧火萨特的月亮井中收集一份被腐化的水的样本，把它交给血毒哨所的温娜·哈萨德。

tasks.name: 加德纳尔的势力
tasks.objective_text_en: Enter Jaedenar and slay 4 Jaedenar Hounds, 4 Jaedenar Guardsmen, 6 Jaedenar Adepts, and 6 Jaedenar Cultists before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 到加德纳尔去杀掉4个加德纳尔恶犬、4个加德纳尔守护者、6个加德纳尔精兵和6个加德纳尔祭司，然后向费伍德森林的格雷塔·苔蹄复命。

tasks.name: 奇怪的红钥匙
tasks.objective_text_en: Search through Jaedenar to discover what the Blood Red Key is used for.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 搜寻加德纳尔，找出血红钥匙的用途。

tasks.name: 特雷·莱弗治的残骸
tasks.objective_text_en: Return the Remains of Trey Lightforge to Jessir Moonbow in Felwood.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将特雷·莱弗治的残骸交给费伍德森林的杰希尔·月弓。

tasks.name: 最后一战
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill Overlord Ror and return his claw to Dreka'Sur at Bloodvenom Post in Felwood.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀死主宰洛尔，把他的爪子交给费伍德森林血毒岗哨的德雷卡苏。

tasks.name: 找回钥匙！
tasks.objective_text_en: Elder Torntusk at Jintha'alor wants you to kill Hitah'ya the Keeper to get the Shackle Key to his bindings. Return to Elder Torntusk when you have recovered the key.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 辛萨罗的断齿长者要求你杀掉守护者希坦亚，并用她身上的镣铐钥匙打开他的镣铐。当你找到钥匙之后就回到他那里去。

tasks.name: 通缉：邪恶祭司海克斯和她的爪牙
tasks.english_name: Wanted: Vile Priestess Hexx and Her Minions
tasks.objective_text_en: You have been ordered to slay Vile Priestess Hexx and 5 Vilebranch Aman'zasi Guards. See Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands once this task is complete.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 你必须杀掉邪恶祭司海克斯和5名邪枝精英守卫。任务完成之后回到辛特兰的恶齿村，向断齿族长报告。 /  / 你可以在辛特兰的邪枝巨魔城市辛萨罗的顶部找到他们。

tasks.name: 不和谐的烈焰
tasks.objective_text_en: Travel to the quarry in Blackrock Mountain and slay Overmaster Pyron. Return to Thunderheart when you have completed this assignment.

tasks.name: 小帕米拉
tasks.objective_text_en: Find Pamela Redpath in Darrowshire.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在达隆郡找到帕米拉·雷德帕斯。

tasks.name: 帕米拉的洋娃娃
tasks.objective_text_en: Find Pamela's doll.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 找到帕米拉的洋娃娃。

tasks.name: 玛莱恩姑妈
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Marlene, south of the Ruins of Andorhal.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与安多哈尔废墟南边的玛莱恩谈一谈。

tasks.name: 古怪的历史学家
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring Joseph's Wedding Ring to Chromie.

tasks.name: 达隆郡的英雄
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring Davil's Libram and Redpath's Shield to Carlin Redpath.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把达维的圣契和雷德帕斯之盾交给卡林·雷德帕斯。

tasks.name: 达隆郡的恶魔
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Skull of Horgus and the Shattered Sword of Marduk to Carlin Redpath at Light's Hope Chapel.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将霍古斯的徽记和马杜克的破碎之剑交给圣光之愿礼拜堂的卡林·雷德帕斯。

tasks.name: 达隆郡的掠夺者
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 5 Resonating Skulls and the Mystic Crystal to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把5个共鸣徽记和神秘水晶交给东瘟疫之地的卡林·雷德帕斯。

tasks.name: 卡林·雷德帕斯
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Extended Annals of Darrowshire to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将《达隆镇全史》交给东瘟疫之地的卡林·雷德帕斯。

tasks.name: 卡林叔叔
tasks.objective_text_en: Find Carlin Redpath.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 找到卡林·雷德帕斯。

tasks.name: 小妹妹帕米拉
tasks.objective_text_en: Find Pamela Redpath in Darrowshire.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在达隆郡里找到帕米拉·雷德帕斯。

tasks.name: 返回克罗米身边
tasks.objective_text_en: Take the Bundle of Relics to Chromie in Andorhal.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将一包遗物交给安多哈尔的克罗米。

tasks.name: 隐藏的宝藏
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring Joseph's Key to Joseph's Chest.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 用约瑟夫的钥匙打开约瑟夫的箱子。

tasks.name: 奥古斯图斯的收据册
tasks.objective_text_en: Get Augustus' Receipt Book from the inn in Terrordale.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在恐惧谷的旅店中取得奥古斯图斯的收据册。

tasks.name: 返回丁奇身边
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring Felnok's Package to Tinkee Steamboil at Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把菲诺克的包裹交给燃烧平原烈焰峰的丁奇·斯迪波尔。

tasks.name: 永望镇报告
tasks.objective_text_en: Deliver the Everlook Report to Argent Officer Garush at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把永望镇报告送给西瘟疫地亡灵壁垒的银色黎明军官加鲁什。

tasks.name: 尼古拉斯·瑟伦霍夫公爵
tasks.objective_text_en: Deliver the book, "Studies in Spirit Speaking", to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff at Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将《灵语研究》这本书交给东瘟疫之地圣光之愿礼拜堂的尼古拉斯·瑟伦霍夫公爵。

finish_entities.name: 尼古拉斯·瑟伦霍夫公爵

tasks.name: 临危不惧
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring Pestlezugg's Un'Goro Report to Zilzibin Drumlore in Orgrimmar.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把匹斯特苏格的安戈洛报告交给奥格瑞玛斯的基尔兹宾·鼓眼。

tasks.name: 异种蝎的远征
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与加基森的炼金师匹斯特苏格谈一谈。

tasks.name: 临危不惧
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Bank Voucher to Karus in the bank of Orgrimmar.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把银行赠券交给奥格瑞玛银行的卡鲁斯。

tasks.name: 拉瑞安和穆尔金
tasks.objective_text_en: Hunt 5 Bloodpetal Lashers, 5 Bloodpetal Threshers, 5 Bloodpetal Flayers and 5 Bloodpetal Trappers for Larion at Marshal's Refuge.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 为马绍尔营地里的拉瑞安杀掉5个血瓣花鞭笞者、5个血瓣花捕兽者、5个血瓣花掠夺者和5个血瓣花猛击者。

tasks.name: 安戈洛的猩猩
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 2 Un'Goro Gorilla Pelts, 2 Un'Goro Stomper Pelts, and 2 Un'Goro Thunderer Pelts to Torwa Pathfinder at the entrance of Un'Goro Crater.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将2块安戈洛猩猩的皮、2块安戈洛大猩猩的皮和2块安戈洛巨猩猩的皮交给安戈洛环形山入口处的托尔瓦·寻路者。

tasks.name: 走丢了！
tasks.objective_text_en: Find Ringo at Fire Plume Ridge.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在火羽山找到林格。

tasks.name: 杰雷米亚的忧伤
tasks.objective_text_en: Find Jeremiah Payson in the Undercity and see if he is in fact Jeremiah Felstone. If he is, then perhaps he'd like the package Janice Felstone made for him.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在幽暗城找到杰雷米亚·派森并查明他是否就是你要找的杰雷米亚·费尔斯通。如果他是的话，那么他可能会想要拿到詹妮丝·费尔斯通寄给他的包裹。

tasks.name: 七贤石板
tasks.objective_text_en: Collect the Tablet Transcript.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 取得石板拓文。

tasks.name: 雏龙精华
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 8 Broodling Essence and the Draco-Incarcinatrix 900 to Tinkee Steamboil at the Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将龙灵采集器900型和8份雏龙精华交给燃烧平原烈焰峰的丁奇-斯迪波尔。

tasks.name: 菲诺克
tasks.objective_text_en: Give Tinkee's Letter to Felnok Steelspring at Everlook in Winterspring.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把丁奇的信交给冬泉谷永望镇的菲诺克。

tasks.name: 啊，安多哈尔！
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring Araj's Phylactery Shard to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

tasks.name: 迟到总比不到好
tasks.objective_text_en: The ramblings of the ghostly woman indicated that she needed a package delivered. She claimed that it was where her horse was. As to where the horse is or where the package was to be delivered - the ghost remains incomprehensible.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 这个女人的幽灵告诉你她要送出一只包裹。她说那只包裹就在她的马旁边。至于马在哪里或者包裹要送到哪里去，她却根本没有说。

tasks.name: 迟到总比不到好
tasks.objective_text_en: Check with the Royal Overseers of the Undercity to learn the whereabouts of a Jeremiah Felstone. There is usually a census officer located near guild and tabard registration.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与幽暗城的皇家管理人巴哈乌斯协商，查找杰雷米亚·费尔斯通的下落。通常在公会注册处附近会有一个人口普查官。

tasks.name: 好运护符
tasks.objective_text_en: Return to Janice Felstone in Western Plaguelands her Good Luck Half-Charm.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把半个好运护符还给西瘟疫之地的詹妮丝-费尔斯通。

tasks.name: 两半合一
tasks.objective_text_en: Locate the other half of the Good Luck Charm somewhere on the Felstone Farm in Western Plaguelands and reassemble it.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在西瘟疫之地的费尔斯通农场某地找到另外一半好运护符，并把两半护符合并。 /  / 把好运护符交给西瘟疫之地费尔斯通农场的詹妮丝·费尔斯通。

tasks.name: 战斗的号角：瘟疫之地！
tasks.english_name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
tasks.objective_text_en: Seek out High Executor Derrington. His base camp is located at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glade and the Undercity.

tasks.name: 战斗的号角：瘟疫之地！
tasks.english_name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
tasks.objective_text_en: Seek out High Executor Derrington. His base camp is located at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glade and the Undercity.

tasks.name: 战斗的号角：瘟疫之地！
tasks.english_name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
tasks.objective_text_en: Seek out High Executor Derrington. His base camp is located at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glades and the Undercity.

tasks.name: 标记哨塔
tasks.objective_text_en: Using the Beacon Torch, mark each tower in Andorhal; you will need to stand in the doorway of the tower to successfully mark it.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 使用信号火炬为安多哈尔城中的四座哨塔做上标记，你必须站在哨塔门口才能成功地进行标记。 /  / 在做完了标记之后，将信号火炬还给西瘟疫之地亡灵壁垒的高级执行官德灵顿。

tasks.name: 达隆郡的历史
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Annals of Darrowshire to Chromie in Andorhal.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把《达隆郡的历史》交给安多哈尔的克罗米。

tasks.name: 瘟疫之锅
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

tasks.name: 返回亡灵壁垒
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Filled Felstone Field Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把费尔斯通农场的样本瓶交给西瘟疫之地亡灵壁垒的暗影牧师范蒂丝。

tasks.name: 返回亡灵壁垒
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Filled Dalson's Tears Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把装满的达尔松眼泪之瓶交给西瘟疫之地亡灵壁垒的暗影牧师范蒂丝。

tasks.name: 返回亡灵壁垒
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Filled Writhing Haunt Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at The Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把嚎哭鬼屋的样本瓶交给西瘟疫之地亡灵壁垒的暗影牧师范蒂丝。

tasks.name: 返回亡灵壁垒
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Filled Gahrron's Withering Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把盖罗恩农场的样本瓶交给西瘟疫之地亡灵壁垒的暗影牧师范蒂丝。
