finish_entities.name: 银色黎明军官普尔哈特

start_entities.name: 银色黎明军需官莱斯巴克

finish_entities.name: 银色黎明军需官莱斯巴克

tasks.name: 战斗的号角：瘟疫之地！
tasks.english_name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
tasks.objective_text_en: Seek out High Executor Derrington. His base camp is located at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glade and the Undercity.

tasks.name: 净化费伍德
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 15 Blood Amber to Maybess Riverbreeze in Felwood.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 收集15颗血琥珀，把它们交给费伍德森林的梅贝丝·河风。

tasks.name: 资源竞赛
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Mark of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.

tasks.name: 究根问底
tasks.objective_text_en: Krakle in Un'Goro Crater wants you to find the hottest area of Fire Plume Ridge.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 安戈洛尔环形山的克拉兰克要你去找到火羽山中温度最高的地方。 /  / 当你找到一个看上去很热的地方时，就右键点击温度计来测量当地的温度。不断尝试，直到你找到温度最高的地方。

tasks.name: 新的泉水
tasks.objective_text_en: Travel to Winterspring and speak with Donova Snowden.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 到冬泉谷去和多诺瓦·雪山谈一谈。

tasks.name: 当心翼手龙
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill 10 Frenzied Pterrordax, then speak to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Refuge.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀掉10只狂怒的翼手龙，然后向马绍尔营地的斯普拉格·弗劳克报告。

tasks.name: 火山的活动
tasks.objective_text_en: Collect 9 samples of Un'Goro Ash from the fire elementals around the volcano in Un'Goro Crater, and return them to Liv Rizzlefix in Ratchet.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 到安戈洛环形山的火山中去，从那里的元素身上收集9份安戈洛灰烬，把它们交给棘齿城的莉芙·雷兹菲克斯。

tasks.name: 大自然的苦楚
tasks.objective_text_en: Destroy 8 Diseased Wolves, and then return to Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt, Western Plaguelands.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 消灭8只生病的狼，然后去找西瘟疫之地嚎哭鬼屋的穆格雷斯·深水。

tasks.name: 雕文橡木枝
tasks.objective_text_en: Based on the magic enchanted within the Glyphed Oaken Branch, its delivery to the Cenarion Circle in Thunder Bluff is the next step the tauren druid sought. Seek one of the druids there for assistance.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 根据雕文橡木枝上面所附加的魔法，这个牛头人德鲁伊本来准备把它交给雷霆崖的塞纳里奥议会。看来你应该到那里去找一个德鲁伊，并寻求他的帮助。

tasks.name: 目标：费尔斯通农场
tasks.objective_text_en: Go to Felstone Field in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there. It may have a key that will allow access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Felstone Field Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 到西瘟疫之地的费尔斯通农场去，找到并击败那里的护锅者，用它的钥匙打开瘟疫之锅。你必须随身携带费尔斯通农场的空瓶来采集瘟疫之锅中的毒药样本。

tasks.name: 血染的天空
tasks.objective_text_en: Slay 30 Plaguebats and return to Tirion Fordring.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀死30只瘟疫蝙蝠，然后向提里奥·弗丁复命。

tasks.name: 腐肉虫
tasks.objective_text_en: Seek out the Carrion Grubs and Devourers of the region. Slay them and harvest their meat. Return to Tirion Fordring when you have gathered 15 Slabs of Carrion Worm Meat.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在东瘟疫之地搜索腐肉虫和腐肉吞噬者。杀了它们并收集它们的肉。当你收集到15块食腐虫肉块之后，就回到提里奥·弗丁那里。

tasks.name: 失落的荣耀
tasks.objective_text_en: Travel to Northdale, in the northeastern region of the Eastern Plaguelands, and recover the Symbol of Lost Honor. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 到东瘟疫之地东北部的北谷去，找到失落荣耀的象征。完成目标之后向提里奥·弗丁复命。

tasks.name: 爱与家庭
tasks.objective_text_en: Travel to island of Caer Darrow, in the south-central region of the Plaguelands, and look for any clues as to the whereabouts of the painting.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 到凯尔达隆岛去，寻找关于那副画的线索。凯尔达隆岛在瘟疫之地南部的湖中央。

tasks.name: 雪怪计划！
tasks.objective_text_en: Collect 10 Thick Yeti Furs for Umi Rumplesnicker in Everlook.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 为永望镇的乌米收集10张厚雪人毛皮。

tasks.name: 冰风奇美拉角
tasks.objective_text_en: Collect 8 Uncracked Chillwind Horns.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 收集8支完整的冰风奇美拉角。

tasks.name: 守护秘密
tasks.objective_text_en: Take the Blue-feathered Necklace to Trull Failbane at Bloodvenom Post.

tasks.name: 守护秘密
tasks.objective_text_en: Take the Blue-feathered Necklace to Nara Wildmane.

tasks.name: 冬泉火酒
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Empty Firewater Flask to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将空的火酒瓶交给冬泉谷的多诺瓦·雪山。

tasks.name: 堕落熊怪
tasks.objective_text_en: Search the Deadwood furbolg camp in northern Felwood for a clue.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 搜寻费伍德森林北部的死木熊怪的营帐，继续寻找线索。

tasks.name: 神秘的粘液
tasks.objective_text_en: Report back to Donova Snowden with your findings.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将你的发现报告给多诺瓦·雪山。

tasks.name: 剧毒之水
tasks.objective_text_en: Collect 3 Toxic Horror Droplets for Donova Snowden in Winterspring.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 为冬泉谷的多诺瓦·雪山收集3份剧毒水滴。

tasks.name: 最后一片
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Crudely-written Log to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把潦草的日志交给冬泉谷的多诺瓦-雪山。

tasks.name: 熊怪酋长的话
tasks.objective_text_en: Take the Crudely-written Log to Kelek Skykeeper in southern Felwood.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将潦草的日志交给费伍德森林南部的科雷克-望天。

tasks.name: 冬泉谷的麻烦！
tasks.objective_text_en: Find Donova Snowden near the hot springs in Winterspring.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 到冬泉谷的温泉附近去找到多诺瓦·雪山。

tasks.name: 擒虫先擒王
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring a Gorishi Scent Gland and 5 Un'Goro Soil samples to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把一份格里什信息素和5份安戈洛的泥土样本交给加基森的炼金师匹斯特苏格。

tasks.name: 克罗格鲁尔
tasks.objective_text_en: Recover Sha'ni's Nose-Ring from Krom'Grul and return it to Thal'trak in Kargath. Search the various caves and mines in Dreadmaul Rock.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 从克罗格鲁尔手中拿回沙妮的鼻环，把它还给卡加斯的萨特拉克。搜寻巨槌石的每一处山洞和矿井。

tasks.name: 烈焰精华
tasks.objective_text_en: Show Cyrus Therepentous the Black Dragonflight Molt you received from Kalaran Windblade.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 向塞勒斯·萨雷芬图斯展示你从威拉罗克·温布雷那里得到的黑龙皮。

tasks.name: 烈焰精华
tasks.objective_text_en: Show Cyrus Therepentous proof of your worth.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 向塞勒斯·萨雷芬图斯证明你的价值。 /  / 你感觉到塞勒斯似乎对你不屑一顾。

tasks.name: 机器的崛起
tasks.objective_text_en: Venture to the Burning Steppes and recover 10 Fractured Elemental Shards for Hierophant Theodora Mulvadania.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 到燃烧平原去为塞朵拉·穆瓦丹尼收集10块断裂的元素碎片。 /  / 塞朵拉曾经说过，那里的机械傀儡和元素生物是这种碎片的主要来源。

tasks.name: 机器的崛起
tasks.objective_text_en: Take the Elemental Shard Sample to Lotwil Veriatus.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将元素碎片样本交给鲁特维尔·沃拉图斯。 /  / 塞朵拉说鲁特维尔就在东边的一处营地里。

tasks.name: 寻找麦兰达
tasks.objective_text_en: Travel to Uther's Tomb, located in the southern Plaguelands. Show Myranda the Hag Tirion's Gift.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 到瘟疫之地南部的乌瑟尔之墓去，将提里奥的礼物交给巫女麦兰达。

tasks.name: 冬泉谷的枭兽
tasks.objective_text_en: Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to kill 15 Raging Owlbeasts and 15 Ragged Owlbeasts.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 费伍德森林的特鲁尔·法贝恩要你去冬泉谷猎杀15头狂怒的枭兽和15头蓬毛枭兽。

tasks.name: 冬泉谷的枭兽
tasks.objective_text_en: Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to hunt 10 Berserk Owlbeasts in Winterspring.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 费伍德森林的特鲁尔·法贝恩要你去冬泉谷猎杀10头狂暴枭兽。

tasks.name: 冬泉谷的枭兽
tasks.objective_text_en: Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to hunt 13 Moontouched Owlbeasts.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 费伍德森林的特鲁尔·法贝恩要你去冬泉谷猎杀13头月光枭兽。

tasks.name: 北方的死木熊怪
tasks.objective_text_en: Nafien would like you to kill 5 Deadwood Den Watchers, 5 Deadwood Avengers, and 5 Deadwood Shamans.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 格拉兹要你去杀死6个死木守卫、6个死木复仇者和6个死木萨满祭司。

tasks.name: 北方的死木熊怪
tasks.objective_text_en: Nafien would like you to kill 6 Deadwood Den Watchers, 6 Deadwood Avengers, and 6 Deadwood Shamans. Return to him in northern Felwood near the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 格拉兹要你去杀死6个死木守卫、6个死木复仇者和6个死木萨满祭司。

tasks.name: 流亡者塞达尔
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring Zaeldarr's Head to Caretaker Alen at Light's Hope Chapel.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将塞达尔的徽记交给圣光之愿礼拜堂的护理者奥林。

tasks.name: 以往的努力
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring Storm Shadowhoof's Marker to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把斯托姆·影蹄的徽记交给雷霆崖的梅洛·石蹄。

tasks.name: 冬泉熊怪的威胁
tasks.objective_text_en: Donova Snowden in Winterspring wants you to kill 8 Winterfall Pathfinders, 8 Winterfall Den Watchers, and 8 Winterfall Totemics.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 冬泉谷的多诺瓦·雪山要你去杀死8个冬泉探路者、8个冬泉巢穴守卫和8个冬泉图腾师。

tasks.name: 叛徒
tasks.objective_text_en: Destroy the arcane focusing crystal tied to Magus Rimtori and then slay her. Afterwards, take the Head of Magus Rimtori to Ag'tor Bloodfist in Azshara.

tasks.name: 强大的尤尔查
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring U'cha's Pelt to Torwa Pathfinder at the entrance of Un'Goro Crater.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把尤尔查的毛皮交给安戈洛环形山入口处的托尔瓦·寻路者。

tasks.name: 恶魔之名
tasks.objective_text_en: Slay Hetaera and bring back Hetaera's Bloodied Head, Hetaera's Beaten Head, and Hetaera's Bruised Head to Lord Arkkoroc.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀掉赫塔拉，将染血的赫塔拉徽记、破碎的赫塔拉徽记和淤血的赫塔拉徽记交给亚考罗克。

tasks.name: 时间问题
tasks.objective_text_en: Use the Temporal Displacer near one of Andorhal's silos and uncover Temporal Parasites.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在安多哈尔的一处仓库附近使用时光置换器，使时光寄生虫现身。 /  / 杀掉10只时光寄生虫，然后将时光置换器还给西瘟疫之地安多哈尔旅店的克罗米。

tasks.name: 找回时间
tasks.objective_text_en: Locate 5 Andorhal Watches, found in lockboxes amongst the rubble of the city. Return with them to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在安多哈尔城中四处散落的保险箱里找到5只安多哈尔怀表，然后把它们交给西瘟疫之地安多哈尔旅店里的克罗米。

tasks.name: 大自然的苦楚
tasks.objective_text_en: Destroy 8 Diseased Grizzlies, and then return to Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt, Western Plaguelands.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 消灭8只生病的灰熊，然后去找西瘟疫之地嚎哭鬼屋的穆格雷斯·深水。

tasks.name: 目标：达尔松之泪
tasks.objective_text_en: Go to Dalson's Tears in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Dalson's Tears Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 到西瘟疫之地的达尔松之泪去，找到并击败那里的护锅者，用它的钥匙打开瘟疫之锅。你必须随身携带达尔松之泪的空瓶来采集瘟疫之锅中的毒药样本。

tasks.name: 未竟的事业
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill 2 Scarlet Medics, 2 Scarlet Hunters, 2 Scarlet Magi and 2 Scarlet Knights before returning to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀死2个血色医护员、2个血色猎人、2个血色魔法师和2个血色骑士，然后回到西瘟疫之地的科尔斯塔·迪普沙东那儿。

tasks.name: 召唤沙德拉
tasks.objective_text_en: Defeat Shadra at the altar of Shadra'Alor, then bring her venom to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

tasks.name: 达隆郡的保卫者
tasks.objective_text_en: Free 15 Darrowshire Spirits and return to Carlin Redpath.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 释放15个达隆郡居民的灵魂，然后返回卡林·雷德帕斯身边。

tasks.name: 恶魔之犬
tasks.objective_text_en: Slay 20 Plaguehound Runts, 5 Plaguehounds and 5 Frenzied Plaguehounds. Return to Tirion Fordring when the task is complete.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀掉20条瘟疫幼犬、5条瘟疫犬和5条狂怒的瘟疫犬。任务完成之后向提里奥·弗丁复命。

tasks.name: 遗忘的记忆
tasks.objective_text_en: Travel to the Undercroft - at the southernmost section of the Eastern Plaguelands - and recover Taelan's Hammer. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 到东瘟疫之地最南端的墓室去找回泰兰之锤。完成目标之后，返回提里奥-弗丁那里。

tasks.name: 杀戮的理由
tasks.objective_text_en: Travel to Corin's Crossing to the east and slaughter the Scourge that inhabit the town. Collect 7 pieces of Living Rot in under 10 minutes. Use the Mortar and Pestle to grind the Living Rot into Coagulated Rot.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 到东边的考林路口去屠杀镇里的亡灵天灾。在10分钟内收集7块生命腐质，使用研钵和捣杵将其研磨成凝固腐质。

tasks.name: 哈米亚的请求
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill Infiltrator Hameya. Use his key on the Mound of Dirt behind the Undercroft.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀了渗透者哈米亚，用他的钥匙开启墓室后的一堆泥土。

tasks.name: 狮子大开口
tasks.objective_text_en: Smokey LaRue wants you to get 2 Thorium Bars, 1 Golden Rod, 8 Hi-Explosive Bombs, and 8 Unstable Triggers.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 烟鬼拉鲁恩要你拿来2块瑟银锭、1根金棒、8颗高爆炸弹和8个不牢固的扳机。 /  / 你需要找铁匠和工程学技师帮忙制作这些东西。

tasks.name: 烟鬼的炸药
tasks.english_name: When Smokey Sings, I Get Violent
tasks.objective_text_en: Travel to Plaguewood, northwest of Light's Hope. Destroy 8 Scourge Structures by using Smokey's Special Compound at the Mark of Detonation planted inside each building. Smokey has had the Ziggurats and Slaughterhouses marked.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 到圣光之愿礼拜堂西北方的病木林去。在那些有爆炸标记的建筑物中对爆炸标记使用烟鬼的特殊混合物，以此来摧毁8座亡灵天灾建筑。烟鬼已经给通灵塔和屠宰房做上了标记。 /  / 一旦你放置好炸弹，就离那些建筑物远一些，然后尽情欣赏你的杰作吧。 /  / 顺便说一句，烟鬼的特殊混合物相当不稳定......

tasks.name: 讨厌的蝙蝠
tasks.objective_text_en: Slay 20 Noxious Plaguebats and 10 Monstrous Plaguebats. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when you are finished.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀掉20只毒性天灾蝙蝠和10只巨型天灾蝙蝠，然后回到纳萨诺斯·凋零者那里。

tasks.name: 游侠之王的命令
tasks.objective_text_en: Travel to the northern borders of the Eastern Plaguelands and recover the Quel'Thalas Registry. The item is somewhere in the Quel'Lithien lodge.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 到东瘟疫之地的北方边界去找回奎尔萨拉斯名册，这件物品在奎尔林斯小屋的某处。 /  / 另外你还必须杀掉8个游侠、8个巡路者和8个护林者。

tasks.name: 雪怪计划！
tasks.objective_text_en: Collect 2 Pristine Yeti Horns for Umi Rumplesnicker in Everlook.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 为永望镇的乌米收集2支完美的雪人角。

tasks.name: 碎齿熊尤西乌斯
tasks.objective_text_en: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill Ursius.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 永望镇的斯托姆·影蹄想要你去杀死尤西乌斯。

tasks.name: 冰风奇美拉布鲁米兰
tasks.objective_text_en: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill Brumeran.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 永望镇的斯托姆·影蹄想要你去杀死布鲁米兰。

tasks.name: 希洛塔姆
tasks.objective_text_en: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to defeat Shy-Rotam.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 永望镇的斯托姆-影蹄想要你去杀死希洛塔姆。

tasks.name: 冬泉信使
tasks.objective_text_en: Find the Winterfall Runners and stop them from delivering their shipment to Winterfall Village.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 找到冬泉信使，阻止他们向冬泉村运送物品。

tasks.name: 冬泉酋长
tasks.objective_text_en: Donova Snowden in Winterspring wants you to defeat High Chief Winterfall.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 冬泉谷的多诺瓦·雪山要你去击败冬泉酋长。

tasks.name: 雪怪计划！
tasks.objective_text_en: Take Umi's Mechanical Yeti and scare her friends with it:
tasks.objective_text_zh: 带着乌米的机械雪人去吓唬她的朋友： /  / 永望镇的莱加奇（冬泉谷）、加基森的斯普琳科（塔纳利斯），还有马绍尔营地的奎克希尔（安戈洛环形山）。 /  / 当你完成任务之后，把机械雪人还给乌米。

tasks.name: 跨越黑暗之门
tasks.objective_text_en: Travel through the Dark Portal and speak with Nazgrel at Thrallmar.

tasks.name: 捕捉皇后
tasks.objective_text_en: Defeat the Gorishi Hive Queen once she is summoned.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 召唤格里什皇后，然后击败她。 /  / 把格里什皇后的大脑交给加基森的炼金师匹斯特苏格。

tasks.name: 新的边疆
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff about the Cenarion Circle's call to explore the frontiers of Kalimdor.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与雷霆崖长者高地的大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾谈一谈关于议会号召部落成员探索卡利姆多大陆的事情。

finish_entities.name: 大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾

tasks.name: 夺回希利苏斯
tasks.objective_text_en: Talk to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与希利苏斯塞纳里奥要塞的唤风者梅恩·长角谈一谈。

start_entities.name: 塞纳里奥使者托尔·黑蹄

tasks.name: 结伴而行
tasks.objective_text_en: Travel to Fire Plume Ridge, south of Marshal's Refuge.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 到马绍尔营地南边的火羽山去。 /  / 找到火焰使者，并使用图腾除掉它的防护光环。在击败它之后从洞中取得金色火焰。

tasks.name: 找回A-Me 01
tasks.objective_text_en: Find a Mithril Casing and return to A-Me 01 in Un'Goro Crater.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 找到一个秘银外壳，然后回到安戈洛环形山的A-Me 01身边。

tasks.name: 拉克维的诱饵
tasks.objective_text_en: Using the contents of Torwa's Pouch, summon Lar'korwi and defeat him. Then bring Lar'korwi's Head to Torwa Pathfinder near the entrance to Un'Goro Crater.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 使用托尔瓦的麻袋中的东西召唤拉克维并打败它。将拉克维的徽记交给安戈洛环形山入口处的托尔瓦·寻路者。

tasks.name: 南风村的灵魂
tasks.objective_text_en: Free the spirits of 8 Tortured Druids and 8 Tortured Sentinels in Southwind Village, and then return to Layo Starstrike at the Valor's Rest graveyard of Silithus.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在南风村释放8个被折磨的德鲁伊和8个被折磨的哨兵的灵魂，然后向希利苏斯勇士之墓的莱耶·星击复命。

tasks.name: 塔中之巢
tasks.objective_text_en: Scale the tower of Southwind Village and locate a means to stir the silithid hive into activity. Bring back anything unusual you may uncover when doing so to Layo Starstrike at the Valor's Rest graveyard of Silithus.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 爬上南风村的塔，找寻激活异种蝎群的方法。把任何你认为不寻常的东西交给希利苏斯勇士之墓的莱耶·星击。

tasks.name: 档案管理员阿姆伯尔
tasks.objective_text_en: Take the Encrusted Silithid Object to Umber - the Cenarion Circle's archivist - in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将异种蝎粘液包裹的物体交给月光林地永夜港的阿姆伯尔，他是塞纳里奥议会的档案管理员。

tasks.name: 沙漠中的剧毒
tasks.objective_text_en: Beetix Ficklespragg at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to gather 8 Stonelash Scorpid Stingers and 8 Sand Skitterer Fangs. Return to her when you have completed the task.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 希利苏斯塞纳里奥要塞的比提克斯·斯巴格要求你带8个石鞭蝎之刺和8个掠沙蜘蛛的牙齿给他。

tasks.name: 诺格的最后一线希望
tasks.objective_text_en: Beetix Ficklespragg at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to gather 3 Stonelash Pincer Stingers, 3 Stonelash Flayer Stingers and 3 Rock Stalker Fangs.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 希利苏斯塞纳里奥要塞的比提克斯·斯巴格要求你给他带去3个石鞭巨钳蝎之刺、3个石鞭掠夺者之刺和3个石行蜘蛛的牙齿。

tasks.name: 暮光词典
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the three chapters of the Twilight Lexicon to Hermit Ortell in Silithus.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把暮光词典的三个章节交给希利苏斯的隐士奥泰尔。

tasks.name: 保护补给线
tasks.objective_text_en: Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to kill 15 Dredge Strikers.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 希利苏斯塞纳里奥要塞的唤风者梅恩·长角要求你去杀死15只掘泥打击者。

tasks.name: 确保安全
tasks.objective_text_en: Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to slay 20 Dredge Crushers.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 希利苏斯塞纳里奥要塞的唤风者梅恩·长角要求你去杀死20只掘泥摧毁者。

tasks.name: 诺格的背包
tasks.objective_text_en: Retrieve Noggle's Satchel from the mountains in the south of Silithus and return it to him at Cenarion Hold.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 从希利苏斯南部山中找到诺格的背包，然后将它交给塞纳里奥要塞中的诺格。

tasks.name: 通缉：死亡弯钩
tasks.english_name: Wanted - Deathclasp, Terror of the Sands
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring Deathclasp's Pincer to Vish Kozus, Captain of the Guard.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将死亡弯钩的蝎钳交给卫兵队长维斯·库鲁兹。

tasks.name: 暮光的秘密
tasks.objective_text_en: Geologist Larksbane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to collect 8 Twilight Tablet Fragments.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 希利苏斯塞纳里奥要塞的地质学家拉克斯班要你去收集8块暮光石板碎片。

tasks.name: 沙漠隐士
tasks.objective_text_en: Take the restored tablet to Hermit Ortell in Silithus.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把复原的石板带给希利苏斯的隐士奥泰尔。

tasks.name: 摆脱困境
tasks.objective_text_en: Take the Decoded Tablet Parchment to Commander Mar'alith.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把解密石板碑文交给指挥官玛尔利斯。

tasks.name: 真正的信徒
tasks.objective_text_en: Hermit Ortell wants you to bring him 10 Encrypted Twilight Texts
tasks.objective_text_zh: 隐士奥泰尔要你带回10张暮光密文信。

tasks.name: 新的边疆
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff about the Cenarion Circle's call to explore the frontiers of Kalimdor.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与雷霆崖长者高地的大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾谈一谈关于议会号召部落成员探索卡利姆多大陆的事情。

finish_entities.name: 大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾

tasks.name: 女妖之王的勇士
tasks.english_name: The Champion of the Banshee Queen
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Nathanos Blightcaller in the Eastern Plaguelands. He is said to have taken up residence at the Marris Stead.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与东瘟疫之地的纳萨诺斯·凋零者谈一谈。据说他居住在玛瑞斯农场。

tasks.name: 废土
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Layo Starstrike near the Valor's Rest graveyard of Silithus, showing him Rabine's Letter.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在希利苏斯的勇士之墓附近找莱耶·星击谈谈，把拉比恩的信交给他。

tasks.name: 发现过去的秘密
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Rabine Saturna in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与月光林地永夜港的拉比恩·萨图纳谈一谈。

tasks.name: 目标：嚎哭鬼屋
tasks.objective_text_en: Go to the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Writhing Haunt Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 到西瘟疫之地的嚎哭鬼屋去，找到并击败那里的护锅者，用它的钥匙打开瘟疫之锅。你必须随身携带嚎哭鬼屋的空瓶来采集瘟疫之锅中的毒药样本。

tasks.name: 目标：盖罗恩农场
tasks.objective_text_en: Go to Gahrron's Withering in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Gahrron's Withering Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 到西瘟疫之地的盖罗恩农场去，找到并击败那里的护锅者，用它的钥匙打开瘟疫之锅。你必须随身携带盖罗恩农场的空瓶来采集瘟疫之锅中的毒药样本。

tasks.name: 巴罗夫的继承人
tasks.objective_text_en: Travel to Chillwind Camp - Alliance territory - and assassinate Weldon Barov. Take his head and return to Alexi Barov.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 到冰风岗——联盟的领地——去暗杀维尔顿-巴罗夫。把他的脑袋交给阿莱克斯-巴罗夫。 /  / 要多加小心，联盟也许对维尔顿实施了严密的保护。

tasks.name: 未完的任务
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill Huntsman Radley and Cavalier Durgen before returning to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀掉猎人莱德雷和骑士杜尔根，然后向西瘟疫之地的科尔斯塔·迪普沙东复命。

tasks.name: 禁锢我们的石头
tasks.objective_text_en: Free nine Servants of Razelikh, three Servants of Sevine, three Servants of Allistarj, and three Servants of Grol. Return to the Fallen Hero when your task is complete. You must remain within close proximity of the stones or the process will fail.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 解救九个拉瑟莱克的仆从、三个瑟温妮的仆从、三个奥利斯塔的仆从和三个戈洛尔的仆从。完成任务后，回到部落英雄的灵魂这里。

tasks.name: 收集破碎的护符
tasks.objective_text_en: Slay Grol the Destroyer, Lady Sevine, and Archmage Allistarj. From their corpses take the Amulet of Grol, the Amulet of Sevine, and the Amulet of Allistarj.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀掉毁灭者戈洛尔、瑟温妮，以及大法师奥利斯塔。从他们到尸体上拿到戈洛尔的护符、瑟温妮的护符和奥利斯塔的护符。 /  / 记住使用你的魔化艾萨拉水晶武器来削弱他们，否则他们是无法被杀死的——你必须小心谨慎地使用你的武器......

tasks.name: 恶魔拉瑟莱克
tasks.objective_text_en: Destroy Razelikh the Defiler and return the Severed Horn of the Defiler to the Fallen Hero of the Horde. You will also need to return the Ward of the Defiler so that the Fallen Hero can destroy it, preventing it from ever falling into the wrong hands.

tasks.name: 光明的惩戒
tasks.objective_text_en: Return to Jaedenar and kill the succubus Rakaiah before finding the Remains of Trey Lightforge.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 回到加德纳尔杀了魅魔拉凯雅，然后找到特雷·莱弗治的残骸。

tasks.name: 最终一击
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill Moora and Salia, and bring Shadow Lord Fel'dan's Head to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀掉米莱恩和萨莉亚，并把暗影领主费尔丹的徽记交给费伍德森林的格雷塔·苔蹄。

tasks.name: 新的边疆
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff about the Cenarion Circle's call to explore the frontiers of Kalimdor.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与雷霆崖长者高地的大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾谈一谈关于议会号召部落成员探索卡利姆多大陆的事情。

finish_entities.name: 大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾

tasks.name: 拉比恩·萨图纳
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Rabine Saturna in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade. Moonglade lies between Felwood and Winterspring, accessible through a path out of Timbermaw Hold.
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与月光林地永夜港的拉比恩·萨图纳谈一谈。月光林地在费伍德森林和冬泉谷之间，可以从木喉要塞中的一条通道抵达那里。
